title: Perussuomalaiset lupaa leikkauslistaansa torstaille
content:
Perussuomalaiset aikoo julkaista torstaina ehdotuksensa sopeutuskeinoista ensi vaalikaudelle. Puolue lupaa, että tarjolla on lähinnä saksimista, ei veronkiristyksiä.

Puolueen puheenjohtaja, valtiovarainministeri Riikka Purra kertoi esitysaikataulusta keskiviikkona eduskunnassa toimittajille.

Hänen mukaansa sopeutuslista painottuu voimakkaasti menoleikkauksiin.

Puolue ei esitä työhön eikä yrittämiseen veronkiristyksiä.

MIKÄÄN AIHEALUE ei Purran mukaan ole suojassa leikkauksilta.

Puolue aikoo esittää säästöjä etenkin maahanmuuton kuluihin.

Eläkkeitäkään ei voida sulkea sopeutusten ulkopuolelle, mutta Purra ei vielä avannut tarkemmin puolueen ehdotusta.

Kokonaisuus on puheenjohtajan mukaan vaaditun kokoinen, hieman isompikin.

PUOLUEIDEN säästölistojen taustalla on parlamentaarinen velkajarrusopimus, jonka mukaan julkista taloutta tulee sopeuttaa ensi vaalikaudella 8-11 miljardia euroa tämänhetkisen arvion mukaan.

Kokoomus julkaisi oman, yhdeksän miljardin suuruisen sopeutusehdotuksensa syyskuun lopussa.

title: Runo nostaa metelin ja perhesuhteissa kuohuu
content:
Lahden kaupunginteatterin kevään 2027 uutuuksissa runo synnyttää poliittisen kohun ja läheiset perhesuhteet joutuvat koetukselle. Ohjelmistossa nähdään kaksi kantaesitystä ja yksi suomenkielinen kantaesitys.

Ennen sosiaalista mediaa meillä oli Huuto. Vuonna 1969 Yleisradion radioteatteri esitti yhdysvaltalaisen beat-runoilijan Allen Ginsbergin kulttirunon Huudon. Kansanedustaja Arne Berner teki ohjelmasta eduskuntakyselyn, jonka allekirjoitti 83 kansanedustajaa eri puolueista. Runon ympärille kasvoi valtakunnallinen kiista, josta eduskunta keskusteli vaalikeväänä kiivaasti neljä tuntia.

Lauri Maijalan käsikirjoittama ja ohjaama Huuto ja meteli saa kantaesityksensä 30.1.2027 Suurella näyttämöllä. Teos perustuu Yleisradion radioteatterin silloisen johtajan Pekka Lounelan ja dramaturgi Jyrki Mäntylän samannimiseen kirjaan sekä aikakauden lehtijuttuihin, uutisiin ja eduskunnan pöytäkirjoihin.

Maijalan käsissä Suuri näyttämö muuntautuu hämyiseksi 1960-luvun jazzklubiksi. Yhdentoista näyttelijän voimin esitys yhdistää fiktiolla terästetyn draaman ja elävän jazzmusiikin, kun yhden runon ympärille syntynyt kohu paisuu hallitsemattomaksi meteliksi. Samalla se vie katsojan keskelle kiistaa taiteen, sananvapauden ja julkisen keskustelun rajoista.

Rooleissa nähdään Aki Raiskio, Anna Kuusamo, Aurora Manninen, Jori Halttunen, Mikko Jurkka, Nenna Tyni, Petteri Hautala, Saana Hyvärinen, Teemu Palosaari, Toni Nikka ja Vilma Kinnunen.

Allergia laukaisee perheen sisäisen valtataistelun

Perheen arki järkkyy, kun isän allergiatestit paljastavat vakavan tilanteen. Kodin on oltava pölytön ja perheen on hankkiuduttava koirasta eroon. Vanha, omapäinen ja muiden silmissä lievästi sanottuna luonnevikainen koira, Gerppu ei kuitenkaan kelpaa kenellekään.

title: Satokausi on pulkassa, vuodenkierto vaihtumassa uuteen – aika juhlia kekriä!
content:
Ympäri maailmaa löytyy juhlia sadonkorjuulle, vainajien muistamiselle ja vuoden vaihtumiselle. Kotoisen kekrimme sukulaisiin kuuluvat esimerkiksi kelttien Samhain, katolilaisen pyhäinpäivän ja Samhainin yhdistelmänä Yhdysvalloissa syntynyt Halloween ja meksikolaisten Kuolleiden päivä.

Kekrin juuret ulottuvat satojen vuosien päähän maataloudellisen satovuoden taitoskohtaan ajoittuvaan juhlintaan. Kekrin viettämisen ajankohta on vaihdellut syyskesästä myöhäissyksyyn sen mukaan, miten missäkin talossa on saatu kasvukauden työt valmiiksi.

1800-luvulla yhteiskunnan kehittymisen myötä kekrin viettämisen ajankohtaa täsmennettiin, ja se ajoitettiin pyhäinmiesten päivän yhteyteen marraskuun alkuun. Vuodesta 1955 pyhäinpäivä eli kekri on ollut nykyisellä paikallaan marraskuun ensimmäisenä lauantaina. Alun perin kekriin liittyneiden perinteiden, tapojen ja leikkien piirteitä löytyy nykyisin joulun ja uudenvuoden ajan vietosta.

title: Colorado Marijuana Regulators Failed to Protect Consumers From Potential Contamination, Audit Finds
content:
The agency charged with regulating Colorado’s first-in-the-nation legal recreational marijuana market potentially put consumers at risk of using contaminated products, a new state audit found.

The report pointed to inconsistent oversight by the Marijuana Enforcement Division and loose state rules around testing marijuana products or contaminants. As a result, it found, nearly 75% of marijuana processed for eventual sale from 2023 through 2025 evaded testing for pesticides.

The audit, released Monday, identified a host of issues, including regulators’ failure to meet regular inspection schedules or to conduct sufficient random checks at dispensaries for contaminated products. It also found that delayed agency warnings to the public allowed potentially contaminated products to remain on shelves for months, sometimes years.

The audit’s conclusions echo several findings of an investigation this year by The Denver Gazette and ProPublica into the Marijuana Enforcement Division’s lapses in policing contaminants entering the legal marketplace.

title: Minä töissä: näytelmäkirjailija Markku Hoikkala
content:
Markku Hoikkala

Olen 70-vuotias reilun päivätyön tehnyt näytelmäkirjailija ja runoilija. Kuten useimmat alan ihmiset, olen kirjoittanut näytelmien lisäksi myös elokuviin, televisioon, lehtiin ja radioon. Näytelmiä tai sellaisiksi luettavia tekstejä on kertynyt noin 40, ja kaikkiaan teoksia on vajaat 80. Viimeiset kuusi vuotta olen ollut taiteilijaeläkkeellä, mutta kirjoittaminen jatkuu edelleen.

Olen saanut joitakin teatteri- ja videopalkintoja, ja niistä minulle on ollut merkittävä Olavi Veistäjä -palkinto.

Yksi elämäni tärkeimmistä vaiheista alkoi vuonna 1985, kun olin perustamassa Teatteri Quo Vadista. Rakensin teatterille jurtan, ja kiersimme sen kanssa Eurooppaa kymmenen vuotta. Ne vuodet tien päällä ja esitykset jurtan sisällä ovat muokanneet millaista teatteria haluan tehdä.

Olen kirjoittanut myös suurille näyttämöille, mutta tunnen omimmaksi pienet näyttämöt. Niissä katsoja on lähellä, ramppi häviää, teksti hengittää ja nyanssit erottuvat. Siksi pidän itse tärkeimpinä töinäni Kyykivi-runotrafiikkia ja teosta Kulkukoira todistaa että on.

Mitä on työpöydälläsi tällä hetkellä tai mikä teos saa ensi-iltansa piakkoin?

title: Egypt: End judicial harassment of Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Atallah
content:
Responding to the news that Lina Atallah, editor-in-chief of independent outlet Mada Masr, has been summoned to appear before Egypt’s Supreme State Security Prosecution (SSSP) today for investigation in a new criminal case against her, Amnesty International’s Senior Director for Regional Impact, Yasmine Ahmed, said:

“It is utterly disgraceful that the Egyptian authorities are once again targeting Lina Atallah for the brave and professional reporting by her team at Mada Masr. This is the sixth case against Mada Masr and its journalists in six years, illustrating the Egyptian authorities’ relentless harassment of independent journalists who challenge the state-controlled narrative.

“Lina Atallah has been bravely leading one of the few remaining independent media outlets in Egypt and should never have been targeted with these successive investigations. Egyptian authorities must immediately end all judicial harassment against her and Mada Masr staff.

title: Revealed: Expensive gas behind ‘nearly 90%’ of rise in UK electricity bills
content:
A surge in wholesale costs driven by expensive gas is responsible for nearly 90% of the rise in UK household electricity bills since 2020, reveals new analysis.

The figures, shared with Carbon Brief by thinktank Nesta, show that wholesale gas costs are also behind the vast majority (77%) of the increase in household gas bills.

The analysis firmly contradicts the idea, which has become embedded in UK media and political narratives, that the UK’s net-zero target is to blame for high energy bills.

Andrew Sissons, director for sustainable future at Nesta, tells Carbon Brief that net-zero is, in fact, “helping to shelter Britain from the impact of expensive gas”. He adds: 

“Rising gas prices, not net-zero, have driven most of the recent surge in Britain’s energy bills. Britain is particularly exposed, with over 80% of households connected to gas mains, while our electricity system still relies too much on gas as the marginal unit.”

The analysis comes after the UK government gave its approval for the Jackdaw gas field to be developed in the North Sea, despite stating that it “would not…affect prices”.
snippet: A surge in wholesale costs driven by expensive gas is responsible for nearly 90% of the rise in UK household electricity bills since 2020, reveals new analysis.

title: BSR Policy Briefing 6/2026: Russia’s northwestern regions face growing pressure from the war in Ukraine
content:
Russia’s northwestern regions are facing growing security concerns, financial difficulties and problems with public services as the war in Ukraine continues. In his BSR Policy Briefing 6/2026 analysis, research fellow and analyst Miłosz Bartosiewicz from the Russian Department of the Centre for Eastern Studies (OSW) examines how the war is affecting these regions and their people. The report covers political, security-related, economic, financial as well as social dimensions.

The Northwestern Federal District consists of seven oblasts – Arkhangelsk, Kaliningrad, Leningrad, Murmansk, Novgorod, Pskov, and Vologda; two republics – Karelia and Komi; the Nenets Autonomous Okrug, and the federal city of St. Petersburg. The district borders several NATO countries, including Finland, Sweden, Norway, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, as well as Poland. The location near NATO borders, combined with growing military activity and economic pressure, makes the region important to follow.

title: Strong demand for crisis data checklists but few in place, UNESCO and CODATA survey finds
content:

Strong demand for crisis data checklists but few in place, UNESCO and CODATA survey finds

Most organisations working on disasters, crises and emergencies see value in a checklist for crisis data policies, yet few have one. This is the central finding of a global survey report published by UNESCO and the Committee (ISC) on Data of the International Science Council (CODATA) on 6 October 2026. The findings point to a next phase in which the Data Policies for Times of Crisis (DPTC) Checklist would be tested in practice with interested institutions.

title: The WhatsApp bot that signed up 1,000 people for Palestine in 48 hours
content:
On the night of 1 October 2025, the Israeli navy stopped the boats of the Global Sumud Flotilla in international waters, on their way to Gaza. Many of them had sailed from Barcelona a month earlier, and the people detained included the city’s former mayor, Ada Colau. Within hours there were hundreds of people outside the Israeli consulate on Avinguda Carles III, and the flotilla’s organizers were calling for protests the next evening in every town in Catalonia.

If you were in Catalonia that week and wanted to show up, the hard part was finding out where. The information was spread across Instagram stories, Telegram channels and family group chats, and half of it was out of date by the time it reached you. One WhatsApp number tried to fix that. You wrote to it and it told you what was happening with the boats and where the nearest protest was.

The bot was called Solidaritat amb Palestina (Solidarity with Palestine). It was built by the Barcelona collective procom.dev and it told people in Catalonia what was happening and where to go. It passed 1,000 users in two days, and 80% of them arrived through a forwarded link.

title: “A demand for agency” | Culture Action Europe’s State of Culture 2026 is out
content:
“If this report amounts to one finding above all the others, it is this: recognition was never the finish line, only the starting condition. Culture’s value has rarely been stated this clearly or this often by European institutions and, yet, it still has not been matched by the funding, protection, or governance necessary for it to be realised. Two years ago, the question this report asked was whether culture could be heard at all. This edition asks a harder one: now that it has been, what is it actually allowed to do with that recognition?”
— Lars Ebert, State of Culture 2026

The central contradiction running through State of Culture 2026 is that culture is praised more than ever and protected less than ever. It is a public good in every EU institution’s vocabulary, yet still funded and evaluated as though it were an industrial output, measured in projects, KPIs and short cycles.

title: Impact of PHP vulnerabilities on Wikimedia Cloud Services
content:
On October 20, 2026, we took Wikimedia Cloud Services (WMCS) and other services offline as a precaution due to two significant vulnerabilities that were discovered in PHP, the programming language most of our services rely on. The PHP Foundation published an advisory ahead of the announcement due to the significance of these vulnerabilities. 

Keeping the Wikimedia projects and their users secure and safe is our top priority. A significant amount of information on the Wikimedia projects is public and available for everyone, but our projects necessarily contain some personal information that is critical to keep private. Protecting user privacy is an essential part of free knowledge, and the Wikimedia Foundation Privacy Policy commits us to strive to keep non-public personal information secure.

title: Blogi: Nyt viimeistään punnitaan, onko EU tosissaan ilmastopolitiikkansa kanssa
content:
EU:ssa on von der Leyenin toisen kauden aikana heikennetty ilmastosääntelyn kunnianhimoisuutta, mutta päästökauppajärjestelmän heikentäminen olisi aivan eri mittaluokan suunnanmuutos kuin komission aiemmat sääntelyn keventämisharjoitukset. Viimeistään päästökaupan kohdalla mitataan, kuinka vakavasti EU edelleen suhtautuu ilmastonmuutoksen torjuntaan.

Tämä vuosi on jälleen yksi synkkä lisä alati pahenevien ilmastovuosien pitkään jatkumoon – kesällä saimme todistaa paitsi uusia ennätyshelteitä, myös entistä laajempia maastopaloja. Vuonna 2024 maapallon keskilämpötila ylitti ensimmäistä kertaa kokonaisen kalenterivuoden ajalta 1,5 celsiusasteella esiteollisen ajan tason, eikä kehitys näytä kääntyvän parempaan.

Ilmastokeskustelussa huomio onkin viime vuosina siirtynyt yhä enemmän 2–3 asteen lämpenemiseen. Maailma ei ole ollut valmis sitoutumaan riittäviin päästövähennyksiin, ja nykyisillä toimilla maapallon keskilämpötila on vaarassa nousta 2–3 astetta. Ilman ilmastotoimia lämpeneminen voisi ylittää jopa neljä astetta.

title: January 2026 Protests: Ilya Ben-Rashid Sentenced to Death
content:
According to HRANA, Ilya Ben-Rashid, one of those arrested during the January 2026 protests and currently held in Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan, has been sentenced to death, imprisonment, and additional punishments.

The verdict was issued by Branch 5 of the Isfahan Revolutionary Court and communicated to Ben-Rashid yesterday. Under the ruling, he was sentenced to death on the charge of moharebeh (waging war against God) through participation in the destruction of public property.

The same court also sentenced him to three years, six months, and one day of discretionary imprisonment on the charge of assembly and collusion to commit crimes against national security, and nine months and one day in prison on the charge of propaganda against the regime, with time already served in detention credited toward his sentence.

Additionally, as a supplementary punishment, he was sentenced to a two-year travel ban prohibiting him from leaving the country.

In April of this year, a hearing on the charges against Ben-Rashid was held before the same branch of the court.

title: Burkina Faso Restores Death Penalty
content:
Burkina Faso’s unelected parliament has unanimously adopted a new penal code that restores the death penalty for high treason, terrorism, acts of espionage, parricide and importation of expired or prohibited products. The country had abolished the death penalty for ordinary crimes in 2018 while its last known judicial execution took place in 1988.

Reinstating capital punishment sends a chilling message to critics of the military junta and risks becoming another tool to suppress dissent. Since the September 2022 military coup, Burkina Faso’s junta has steadily dismantled civic and political rights. Authorities have banned media outlets, suspended unions and civil society organizations, abolished multiparty politics, and subjected critics to arbitrary detention, enforced disappearances, unlawful conscription, and torture.

Justice Minister Edasso Rodrigue Bayala defended the decision to reinstate the death penalty as a necessary measure to combat terrorism. He said that armed groups exploited the previous law’s leniency by promising new recruits they would face no more than life imprisonment if convicted of terrorist acts.

title: Museoiden taidekokoelmien verkkojulkaiseminen tarvitsee korvausmallin
content:
Museoiden digitaaliset taidekokoelmat tavoittavat uusia yleisöjä, mutta monella museolla ei ole varaa maksaa taiteilijoille teosten digikäytöstä. Kuvasto esittää lausunnossaan vuodelle 2027 valtion talousarvioon 1,5 miljoonan euron lisäystä, jolla laajennettaisiin taidekokoelmien saatavuutta verkossa ja turvataan taiteilijoiden korvaukset.

Museoiden digitaaliset taidekokoelmat ovat parantaneet taiteen saavutettavuutta. Kansalaiset ovat voineet tutustua vapaasti saatavilla oleviin teoksiin esimerkiksi Finna.fi-palvelussa. Samalla taideteosten tekijät ovat saaneet vuosittain tekijänoikeuskorvauksen teostensa verkkojulkaisemisesta. Valtio on investoinut merkittävästi taideteosten digitointiin.

Kuvasto ja Suomen museoliitto sopivat taidekokoelmien verkkojulkaisemisesta ja taiteilijoiden tekijänoikeuskorvauksista vuosina 2017–2024 voimassa olleessa sopimuksessa. Sen piirissä oli parhaimmillaan 45 museota ja säätiötä. Vuodesta 2025 alkaen museot ja säätiöt ovat voineet jatkaa teosten esittämistä verkossa Kuvaston Taidekokoelmat verkkoon 2.0 -sopimuksella. Sen on solminut yhteensä 29 museota ja säätiötä.

title: Vallan maantiede: Mikä on pelissä, kun Etiopia ja Eritrea etenevät kohti uutta sotaa?
content:
Lähes päivälleen seitsemän vuotta siitä, kun Etiopian pääministeri Abiy Ahmed sai Nobelin rauhanpalkinnon lopetettuaan sodan Eritrean kanssa, hän on matkalla kohti uutta sotaa pohjoista naapuriaan vastaan.

Maiden välinen konflikti uhkaa levitä laajemmaksi sodaksi alueella, jonka geopoliittinen painoarvo on noussut tulikuumaksi tänä vuonna.

Egypti, Somalia ja Eritrea ovat jo ehtineet muodostaa uuden liittouman Etiopiaa vastaan paperilla.

Kaiken keskiössä on Etiopian halu päästä käsiksi Punaiseenmereen. Siellä taistelevat nyt myös Jemenin huthit, jotka hiljattain liittyivät toden teolla mukaan Iranin puolelle Yhdysvaltojen ja Israelin sodassa maata vastaan.

Monen maan intressit kiteytyvät pieneen merikaistaleeseen, ja sota Eritrean ja Eitopian välillä uhkaa koko aluetta.

Mitä tekevät Persianlahden maat, kun taistelu Punaisen meren kontrollista uhkaa eskaloitua entisestään?

title: In 1897, London’s Lampposts Dispensed Hot Coffee, Tea, and “Fluid Beef”
content:
Any reader of Victorian literature will wonder how much a ha’penny was actually worth in those days. For a little more than a year at the very end of that period, it could buy you a cup of coffee, cocoa, milk, tea, or “fluid beef” — which would pour out of a lamppost on the corner. The Pluto Lamp, as it was branded, made its debut at the Victorian Era Exhibition, which was held in 1897 to celebrate the Queen’s Diamond Jubilee. Amid such attractions as a 360-degree panorama of ancient Rome, Pepper’s ghost illusions, and over 1,200 works of art by the likes of J. M. W. Turner, John Constable, and 180 specially selected female artists, a beverage-dispensing streetlight might seem mundane. Yet apart from being a technological marvel in its own way, it also presaged the technology-saturated streets one day to come.

Not long after the Victorian Era Exhibition, Pluto Lamps appeared in several London locations, including Exmouth Street in Clerkenwell, Leicester Square, and Rosebery Avenue. In addition to the illumination of their surroundings, and the drinks warmed by the excess heat thus generated, they in some cases offered postcards and four-to-the-penny cigarettes for sale as well.

title: Rajalaki vaatii jatkuvaa julkista tarkastelua
content:
Eduskunta käsittelee syksyllä 2026 jatkoaikaa rajalaille. Käsittelyn rinnalla on syytä käydä kattavaa julkista keskustelua siitä, millaisia kompromisseja Suomi on valmis tekemään kansallisen turvallisuuden nimissä.

Kesällä 2024 eduskunta sääti niin kutsutun rajalain mahdollistaakseen itärajan sulkemisen vastatoimena Venäjän välineellistämälle maahantulolle, millä tarkoitetaan maahanmuuton hyödyntämistä poliittisena painostuskeinona ohjaamalla kansainvälistä muuttoliikettä kohdevaltioon. Loppuvuodesta 2023 itärajan raja-asemille oli saapunut poikkeuksellinen määrä kolmansista maista lähteneitä turvapaikanhakijoita, ja viranomaiset arvioivat kyseessä olevan Venäjän valtion hybridivaikuttamisoperaatio.

Hybridivaikuttamisen todettiin olevan pyrkimys heikentää kansallista turvallisuutta sekä kuormittaa viranomaisia, ja rajalla arvioitiin olevan riski jopa väkivaltaisiin maahantunkeutumisyrityksiin.

title: Presidentti Oslossa: Tänään otimme askeleen eteenpäin kohti kestävää ja oikeudenmukaista rauhaa
content:
Tasavallan presidentti Alexander Stubb teki työvierailun Osloon tiistaina 20. lokakuuta 2026.

Presidentti Stubb osallistui Ukrainan rauhanprosessia käsitteleviin keskusteluihin, joihin osallistuivat Norjan pääministeri Jonas Gahr Støre, Ukrainan presidentti Volodymyr Zelenskyi sekä Yhdysvaltain erityislähettiläs Steve Witkoff. Erityislähettiläs Jared Kushner osallistui kokoukseen etäyhteyden kautta Yhdysvalloista.

Keskustelujen tavoitteena oli edistää kestävää ja pysyvää rauhaa Ukrainassa sekä käsitellä sodan jälkeistä jälleenrakentamista. Presidentin mukaan tiistain keskusteluissa otettiin askel eteenpäin:

”Suomi on aina rauhan puolella ja työskentelemme yhdessä sen eteen. Rauha vaatii aina kärsivällisyyttä, mutta sota ei odota. Meidän tehtävämme on tehdä kaikki se, mitä pystymme saattaaksemme Venäjän hyökkäyssodan päätökseen. Tuemme Ukrainaa.”

title: Tuliaisia Göteborgista: kirjasto kulttuuritalossa vai kulttuuritalo kirjastossa?
content:
Vierailin syyskuussa työmatkalla Göteborgin seudulla tutustumassa kulttuuritaloihin. Matkaseurue koostui yhdyskuntasuunnittelun asiantuntijoista sekä kulttuurialan ammattilaisista. Tavoitteena oli kerätä ideoita Lempäälän keskustaan suunnitteilla olevan kulttuurikeskuksen kehittämiseen.

Vierailukohteemme Stenungsundissa, Göteborgin Bergsjönissä sekä Härrydan Mölnlyckessä ja Landvetterissa olivat keskenään hyvin erilaisia niin väestörakenteeltaan kuin toimintaympäristöltäänkin. Silti niiden taustalla näkyi yhteinen ajatus siitä, mitä kulttuuritalo kunnassa tarkoittaa.

Ruotsalainen kulturhuset kokoaa saman katon alle palveluita, jotka meillä ehkä edelleenkin sijaitsevat erillään. Kulttuuritalosta voi löytyä kunnan neuvontapiste, työllisyyspalveluja, digiopastusta, elokuvateatteri, näyttelyitä, kahvila, tapahtumasali, luovia työtiloja, äänitysstudioita, tiedeverstas ja luonnollisesti… myös kirjasto.

title: Två nya böcker: Stalins brutala utrensningar och medeltida svensk lag
content:
Hur byggs ett samhälle med rättsprinciper i stället för våld? Och vad händer när staten själv blir ett redskap för terror? Charlotte Cederbom och Anni Reuter riktar ljuset mot medeltidens Sverige och Stalins Sovjetunionen i böcker aktuella på Helsingfors bokmässa.

I Finska öden under Stalins utrensningar skildrar Anni Reuter den länge förtigna förföljelsen av olika finska folkgrupper i Sovjetunionen. Under Stalins tid vid makten 1928–1953 deporterades över 100 000 finskspråkiga, framför allt ingermanländare, till Sibirien, Centralasien och andra avlägsna delar av landet.

– Min avsikt med boken har varit att skapa en helhetsbild av utrensningarna, alltså av den terror och de massdeportationer som alla med någon anknytning till Finland utsattes för, säger Reuter.

Utgående från sin egen släkts historia och genom intervjuer, brev, arkivmaterial och fotografier ger hon en gripande inblick i de drabbades öden: förtrycket i fånglägren, tvångsarbetet, svälten, sjukdomarna och åratalen av rädsla och ovisshet – men också strävan att överleva.

title: ‘I’m always being real’: what on earth persuades disgraced people like Elizabeth Holmes to let the cameras in?
content:
With You Can See Everything, Holmes joins other such high-profile subjects as Lance Armstrong, Imelda Marcos and Anthony Weiner to allow film-makers to document their lives. But do they ever come out well?

In You Can See Everything, convicted fraudster Elizabeth Holmes invites film-makers Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim into her home in a supposed act of “radical transparency”. Holmes is filmed, along with her partner, Billy Evans, and their two young children, in the weeks before starting a prison sentence for defrauding Theranos investors. “The best way for people to see who she is,” Evans says, “is to give as much access as possible into our daily lives”. It may also be the best way to market “Theranos 2.0”, which the couple are working on during filming. But the documentary questions whether Holmes is presenting her authentic self or a manufactured persona. Fielder speaks for the audience when he asks Holmes in a tense exchange whether she’s “being real” with him. “I’m always being real,” she says.

title: TTVK ry hakee juristia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen
content:
Tekijänoikeuden tiedotus- ja valvontakeskus ry (TTVK) on voittoa tavoittelematon, luovien alojen toimijoita laajasti edustava rekisteröity yhdistys. TTVK:n tehtävänä on luovan työn ja yrittämisen mahdollistaminen tekijänoikeuksia turvaamalla. TTVK valvoo jäsenorganisaatioidensa edustamien oikeudenhaltijoiden tekijänoikeuksia puuttumalla aktiivisesti piratismiin sekä ehkäisevin keinoin että tekijänoikeuslain täytäntöönpanolla. Lisäksi TTVK:n tehtävänä on lisätä yleistä tekijänoikeustietoisuutta tarjoamalla tekijänoikeudellista koulutusta ja neuvontaa.

TTVK:n toiminnan ytimen muodostavat tekijänoikeuksien valvonta, koulutus, viestintä ja tekijänoikeuskasvatus sekä yhteiskunnalliseen keskusteluun osallistuminen.

Tässä monipuolisessa tehtävässä pääset hoitamaan täytäntöönpanoa ja muuta tekijänoikeusvalvontaa erityisesti verkkoympäristössä, antamaan yleistä tekijänoikeudellista neuvontaa ja kouluttamaan tekijänoikeuteen liittyvissä asioissa. Työssäsi toimit yhteistyössä niin kotimaisten kuin ulkomaisten oikeudenhaltijoiden sekä poliisin, tullin, syyttäjien ja muiden viranomaisten kanssa. Tulet työskentelemään tiiviisti osana TTVK:n muuta tiimiä.

title: World must cut emissions by 18% in four years ‘to find our way back’, UN says
content:
Action needed to avoid disastrous overshoot of climate targets, according to organisation’s environment body

The world needs to cut carbon emissions by nearly a fifth in the next four years, and by close to half within a decade, to avoid overshooting climate targets by a disastrous margin.

Although the “window has closed” on holding temperature rises to 1.5C, in line with scientific advice, limiting the “overshoot” of that target is still possible, according to the UN Environment Programme (Unep).

title: Waali Language Goes Live on Wikipedia
content:
On Wednesday, 14th October 2026, a language spoken in the sunlit towns and villages of Ghana’s Upper West Region stepped onto the world’s digital stage. Waali has become the tenth Ghanaian language, and the sixth in the Mabia/Mole Dagbani language group supported by the Dagbani Wikimedians User Group, to be approved on Wikipedia. The approval came during the language’s incubation stage in the Wikimedia Incubator. For the Waala people, it is more than a technical decision. It is a declaration that their language, history, and identity belong in the global conversation.

Waali, also spelt Wali or Waalii, is widely spoken across the Upper West Region and in parts of the Savannah Region. Thousands of people use it every day to trade in markets, tell stories, honour traditions, and raise children. Yet for all its vitality, very little research or documentation stands behind it. A language can be alive in the mouths of its speakers and still be nearly invisible in books, databases, and the digital world

title: Cops Warned to Look for ‘Suspicious Behavior’ From People Opposing Flock at City Council Meetings
content:
A federal intelligence center warned police that city council meetings about Flock “may be viewed by extremists as a desirable target,” and told them to be on the lookout for “emotional confrontations” between people who oppose surveillance and government officials, according to a copy of the warning obtained by 404 Media.

The warning, obtained by 404 Media, was issued by the Orange County Intelligence Assessment Center (OCIAC)—a government fusion center—in July to police in California. 404 Media recently obtained the bulletin using a Freedom of Information Act request.

This surveillance bulletin to cops is the latest evidence that police around the country have been told to be on edge during public meetings where people are participating in democracy and utilizing their First Amendment rights about unpopular things the government is doing. We have reported on a spate of people being illegally arrested for extremely minor procedural violations or for cursing at city council meetings about Flock and data centers while participating in constitutionally protected activities.

title: Pen Pushers Help Engineers Keep Ukraine’s Lights On
content:
Russia’s campaign against Ukraine’s energy infrastructure is forcing the country to rethink a system built around large power plants and long transmission lines. The answer is increasingly decentralized generation: smaller gas-fired units, cogeneration, batteries, modular boiler houses, renewables, and backup systems closer to consumers.

Kyiv has been expanding smaller, distributed sources of electricity and heat, alongside storage and backup generation, to make energy supply less vulnerable to Russian strikes. But it still depends on local implementation.

The decisive question will be if Ukraine’s municipalities have the institutional capacity to turn money, equipment, and plans into functioning systems.

In March, comprehensive resilience plans for regions and regional centers were approved. They focused on protection of critical infrastructure, development of distributed generation, backup and alternative power, and decentralization of heat generation. Kyiv said these were long-term measures to strengthen communities beyond a single winter.

title: Osa CSC:n palveluista pois käytöstä varotoimena PHP-haavoittuvuuden takia
content:
Korjattu ohjelmistoversio otetaan käyttöön mahdollisimman pian sen julkaisun jälkeen kaikissa ympäristöissä, joissa PHP on käytössä.

Varotoimena olemme ajaneet alas osan palveluistamme. Tämän toimenpiteen tarkoitus on varotoimenpiteenä suojata palveluja kunnes korjauspäivitykset on tehty. Käyttökatko ei siis johdu siitä, että tiedossamme olisi tapauksia, joissa haavoittuvuutta olisi käytetty hyväksi.

Viestimme palvelukohtaisesti pois käytöstä otettujen palveluiden vastuutahoille.

PHP (Hypertext Preprocessor) on yksi maailman suosituimmista palvelimiin liittyvistä ohjelmointikielistä ja sitä hyödyntää iso osa internetin verkkosivustoista. Teemme päivitykset välittömästi niiden julkaisun jälkeen ja pyrimme palauttamaan palvelut normaalitilaan mahdollisimman nopeasti.

title: "When the Bubble Bursts": Naomi Klein & Astra Taylor on Reclaiming Democracy from AI Oligarchs
content:
We’re joined by Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor, co-authors of the book End Times Fascism, for a wide-ranging conversation on the multitrillion-dollar global investment in artificial intelligence and its reverberating effects around the world.

Klein recently spoke at the People’s AI Assembly, alongside other critics of the artificial intelligence industry, including New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and former chair of the Federal Trade Commission Lina Khan. “The resistance to AI is taking many forms, and it’s really a resistance to oligarch power, which is concentrated in the hands of these tech companies,” Klein tells Democracy Now! “After 50 years of outsourcing and hollowing out of public functions of the state, the very last stage is the outsourcing of thinking, of intelligence itself.”

title: COLOURS, UNICHE, PlaceMUS XR and StratiGraph at BMTA Paestum
content:
COLOURS and fellow Sister projects UNICHE, PlaceMUS XR and StratiGraph will present their digital tools for coloured heritage at a joint workshop organised at the XXVIII Borsa Mediterranea del Turismo Archeologico (BMTA) in Paestum, Italy from 13:00-15:00 on the 29th October.

The aim of the New digital tools and EU funding for museums and heritage workshop which is designed for museums, heritage institutions, conservators-restorers, heritage scientists and other professionals, is to show what these tools can do in practice. Participants can see concrete examples, learn about the projects’ open calls and test the tools directly with the people who develop them.

It is also a good opportunity for organisations interested in applying to the COLOURS and UNICHE open calls. The session is free but registration is appreciated for planning purposes.

Please see the COLOURS website for the programme and further details about the workshop.

title: Norway’s EUSBSR accession opens new opportunities for cooperation in education and social inclusion
content:
Norway’s full participation in the EU Strategy for the Baltic Sea Region (EUSBSR) was officially celebrated in Oslo on 16 October 2026. For Policy Area Education, the occasion was also an opportunity to strengthen dialogue with Norwegian stakeholders and explore new possibilities for cooperation on shared societal challenges.

Norway became the ninth participating country in the EUSBSR on 18 May 2026, marking an important step in strengthening cooperation across the Baltic Sea Region.

The official launch event in Oslo on 16 October brought together Norwegian Minister of Foreign Affairs Espen Barth Eide, Minister of Local Government and Regional Development Bjørnar Skjæran, representatives of the European Commission, Policy Area Coordinators and stakeholders from across the region.

The programme focused on Norway’s role in the Strategy, its longstanding experience of Baltic Sea cooperation and the opportunities that full participation creates for contributing to shared priorities.

title: IJ4EU award winner puts prize money towards new journalism fellowship
content:
IJ4EU grantee Investigate Europe is using its €5,000 IJ4EU Impact Award prize to fund a new fellowship offering aspiring journalists from under-represented backgrounds paid experience in cross-border reporting.

The journalism cooperative has teamed up with the Centre for Investigative Journalism (CIJ) to establish the CIJ Investigate Europe Lyra McKee Fellowship. It will offer one or two part-time paid placements working alongside Investigate Europe’s reporters, according to a CIJ announcement.

Investigate Europe and its partners won a 2025 IJ4EU Impact Award for Deadly Prices, an investigation into unequal access to medicines across Europe. The series examined how opaque pricing arrangements and pharmaceutical industry practices put essential treatments beyond patients’ reach.

The fellowship is open exclusively to graduates of the CIJ’s Lyra McKee bursary scheme, which provides five months of training and mentoring to people seeking to enter journalism or taking their first steps in the profession.

title: AI-kahvit: Tekoäly työkaluna
content:
Tämä Teams-tallenne on osa AI-kahvit-sarjaa, jonka on tuottanut Yleisten kirjastojen tekoälyosaamisen kehittämishanke. AI-kahveilla pohditaan tällä kertaa, mitä tekoälyllä voi tehdä ja miten kirjasto voi tukea asiakkaiden tekoälylukutaitoa ja konkreettista osaamista matalalla kynnyksellä.

Aiheesta puhuu kouluttaja Matleena Laakso. Hän kertoo käytännönläheisesti, miten tekoälyä voi hyödyntää omassa työssä ilman teknistä erityisosaamista, ja käy läpi tekoälylukutaidon määritelmiä ja osaamiskuvauksia. Esimerkit kirjastotyöhön liittyvät muun muassa lukusuositusten ja kirjapiirin keskusteluteemojen ideointiin, visualisointiin ja digipulmien ratkaisemiseen. Kantavana ajatuksena on, että ihminen ideoi, ohjaa ja tarkistaa, ja tekoäly toimii sparraajana. Webinaari järjestettiin 21.10.2026.

Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriö antoi keväällä 2025 Helsingin kaupunginkirjaston valtakunnalliselle kehittämisyksikölle (VAKE) tehtäväksi vastata Yleisten kirjastojen tekoälyosaamisen kehittämishankkeesta. Hankkeen tavoitteena on tukea kirjastokenttää tekoälyn mahdollisuuksien, osaamisen ja käytäntöjen kehittämisessä.

title: Vähä-Kiljavan majoitusrakennuksen kunnostusta suunnittelee Saatsi Arkkitehdit
content:
Safa pyysi syyskuussa avoimellla haulla jäseniltään tarjouksia Vähä-Kiljavan majoitusrakennuksen kunnostuksen tarve- ja hankesuunnitelmasta. Tavoitteena on selvittää rakennuksen kunnostamisen edellytykset ja palauttaa se majoituskäyttöön, arkkitehtoniset ominaispiirteet säilyttäen. Vähä-Kiljava on Arkkitehti Väinö Vähäkallion ja Astrid Vähäkallion vuonna 1937 Suomen Arkkitehtiliitolle lahjoittama jäsenten yhteinen virkistysalue Sääksjärven rannalla, Hyvinkäällä.

Vuonna 1955 perustettu Saatsi Arkkitehdit vaalii vanhaa ja luo uutta terveellistä, kestävää ja merkityksellistä rakennettua kulttuuriperintöä.

Vanhojen rakennusten korjaus- ja muutossuunnittelu on toimiston ydintoimintaa – niin suojeltujen arvorakennusten restauroinnit kuin arkisempienkin rakennusten korjaukset ja muutokset. Saatsi Arkkitehdit toteuttaa myös muun muassa rakennushistoriaselvityksiä, rakennetun kulttuuriympäristön inventointeja, korjattavuuden selvityksiä.

Emilialla on maisemarakentamisen suunnittelijan pätevyys poikkeuksellisen vaativassa luokassa. Pekalla ja toimiston kolmella työntekijällä on korjaus- ja muutostöiden pääsuunnittelijan pätevyys poikkeuksellisen vaativassa luokassa.

title: Publishers want Brussels and London to stop Meta’s new AI terms
content:
BRUSSELS — Europe’s biggest media companies have asked regulators in Brussels and London to stop Meta from introducing new terms they say would let it copy publishers’ websites to build artificial intelligence, as a backlash that began in the U.S. spreads across Europe.

In a letter Monday, the European Publishers Council, whose members include POLITICO’s owner Axel Springer, called on EU competition boss Teresa Ribera and tech chief Henna Virkkunen to press Meta to put the terms on hold before they take effect Oct. 30.

The group wants Brussels to check them against EU copyright and competition law, and has requested an urgent meeting with the teams of both commissioners.

“The Commission remains committed to ensure that Meta’s practices fully comply with all applicable obligations under EU law, including competition rules and the Digital Markets Act,” Commission spokesperson Ricardo Cardoso told POLITICO, referring to the EU’s rulebook for Big Tech. He said Brussels was aware of both Meta’s changes and publishers’ concerns.

title: French students are showing us what protest looks like in the age of viral spectacle
content:
The recent wave of protests in Europe have left us with two striking, viral spectacles of violence and joy. As Limoges’ historic town hall went up in flames, the Orchestre du Nouveau Monde was playing classical music in Paris’ central Place de la République (until the musicians were teargassed by police, that is).

Both scenes offer radically different ways of seeing the protests. The burning town hall offers a powerful image of destruction; the orchestra, of anti-authoritarian collective solidarity. Neither tells the whole story, but their contrast raises important questions: which image will come to represent the protests, and who decides what we see?

France’s demonstrations began with students protesting deteriorating school conditions, including staff shortages and dilapidated buildings. But they quickly intersected with broader anger over living costs and public services.

The unrest also formed part of a wider European moment. On the same weekend, people took to the streets in Spain, Italy, Belgium, Portugal and Albania. Grievances include low wages, rising energy prices and unaffordable housing, each within its own national context.

title: Lehdistökutsu: Liikunta osana kasvatusalan koulutuksia -selvityksen julkistamistilaisuus 4.11.2026
content:
Aika: keskiviikko 4.11.2026 kello 10.00–11.30
Paikka: etänä TEAMS

Valtaosa väestöstä ei täytä liikkumissuosituksia ja liikkuu terveytensä kannalta liian vähän. Väestön riittämättömän liikkumisen edistämiseksi tarvitaan mukaan kaikki hallinnonalat. Mukaan tarvitaan erityisesti koulutuspolitiikka, jotta kasvatus- ja opetusammattilaiset osaisivat omassa työssään edistää liikkumista ja liikuntaa. Tutkimusten mukaan kasvatus- ja opetushenkilöstön liikkumisen ja liikunnan edistämisen osaaminen on yhteydessä lasten liikkumisen edistämiseen.

Valtion liikuntaneuvosto on tilannut selvityksen liikkumisesta ja liikunnasta osana kasvatusalan koulutuksen oppimissisältöjä. Selvitys tuottaa kokonaiskuvan, miten väestön liikkumisen ja liikunnan edistämisen kannalta keskeisten kasvatusalan tutkintojen oppimissisällöissä on huomioitu liikkumisen ja liikunnan edistäminen.

Selvityksessä tarkastellaan mm. kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perustutkintoa ja ammattitutkintoa, yhteisöpedagogin, kasvatustieteen kandidaatin ja maisterin tutkintoa sekä ammatillista opettajankoulutusta ja aikuiskoulutuksen pedagogisia opintoja. Selvityksen toteutuksesta on vastannut MDI.

title: Sivistysporvarien kärsivällisyys alkaa pettää kokoomuksessa
content:
Eero Karisto

Petteri Orpon kaudella kokoomus on liukunut oikealle ja mielistynyt yhteistyöhön perussuomalaisten kanssa. Mutta vaalien lähestyessä kokoomuksesta on tulossa myös perussuomalaisten saalistuksen kohde.

Osa kokoomuslaisista on sanonut ääneen, että haluaa jatkaa yhteistyötä perussuomalaisten kanssa vaalien jälkeenkin. Vaalien lähestyessä kokoomuksessa on kuitenkin muistettu, että puolueet kilpailevat samoista äänestäjistä. Perussuomalaisten kanssa kilpailu on rajua, ja se on jo alkanut.

Vielä vaalikauden puolivälissä oikeistoyhteistyön kannattajien huoli kokoomuksessa oli, että perussuomalaiset saavat vaaleissa liikaa turpiinsa ja jäävät siksi oppositioon. Vähitellen on ymmärretty, että perussuomalaiset ovat menossa kokoomuksen ohi.

Eihän siinä näin pitänyt käydä.

Perussuomalaiset ovat tähän asti saaneet maahanmuuttopolitiikassa ja ympäristöpolitiikassa kaiken, mitä ovat ikinä keksineetkin toivoa, ja bensan hinnassakin kokoomus on tukenut kumppaniaan.

title: Openness in AI development: a path to long-term independence
content:
As concerns grow over deepening dependencies on a handful of Big Tech companies and the outsized influence of the U.S. and China, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk used his speech during July’s inaugural Global Dialogue on AI Governance to call on humans to “take back our agency” over AI. But what does agency over AI really mean? What policies and practices can allow people to shape AI in ways that respect, rather than undermine, human rights? 

This blog post unpacks concrete initiatives that show how openness in AI development can increase people’s agency over AI and advance the development of public interest technology. At the same time, we reflect on how openness is not the same thing as mere access, and how short-term pragmatism can pave the way toward long-term independence.

title: Release Dr Hussam Abu Safiya and 13 other doctors held without charge
content:
CIVICUS and Physicians for Human Rights – Israel add Dr Abu Safiya to the Stand As My Witness campaign, calling for the release of all 14 detained Gaza doctors. 

Johannesburg, 21 October 2026 – Dr Hussam Abu Safiya treated children in northern Gaza until Israeli forces took him from his hospital. Almost two years on, he is still held in inhumane conditions without charge or trial, and he is not alone. 

Dr Abu Safiya, a paediatrician and director of Kamal Adwan Hospital, stayed with his patients through attacks, evacuation orders, and severe medicine shortages. He was detained on 27 December 2024 and has since been held under Israel’s Unlawful Combatants Law, much of the time in solitary confinement and without adequate healthcare.  

Physicians for Human Rights – Israel (PHRI) and his lawyer report repeated severe assaults and a serious decline in his health. In June 2026, Israel’s Supreme Court upheld his detention until at least October.

title: Introducing Our New Surveillance Self-Defense Guide: Online Privacy for Parents and Youth
content:
The internet is a vast and confusing place no matter your age. Trying to help youth engage with it safely and privately is a complicated topic that touches on many different skillsets and ideas. But just because it’s complicated doesn’t mean it’s impossible. We’ve launched our Online Privacy for Parents and Youth Surveillance Self-Defense guide in hopes to provide a framework for finding solutions that work for you. 

EFF rolls out this crucial resource as state and local governments consider ill-advised laws that cut young people off from essential information and experiences. This particularly harms vulnerable youth and marginalized groups who often find safety in supportive online communities they can't access offline. Such laws also entail age gating, which compromises the privacy of all internet users and stifles young users’ ability to learn, grow, and express themselves.

title: In a Vienna Bakery, Fresh Pastries and a Backdoor for Serbian Votes
content:
For the ordinary Viennese, it’s just another neighborhood Balkan bakery.

But to the more than 76,000 Serbians living in the Austrian capital, the shop known as Pekarica — "little bakery" — offers a fragrant touch of home, where orders are exchanged effortlessly in their native tongue as the scent of dough wafts from the oven.

That’s not all. On one recent morning, a customer stepped to the front of the counter, ignoring the steaming trays of braided breads and glossy pretzels entirely.

“Excuse me,” he said. “I was told by my colleagues that I can register to vote here.”

“Yes, you can,” the clerk replied, unfazed by the question. “Not here exactly, but further down. Come, I’ll take you.”

She led him out the door and a few steps down the pavement to the modest storefront housing the Association of Serbs in Austria. Inside, the walls were plastered with campaign posters, slogans, and portraits of Serbia’s long-serving president, Aleksandar Vučić, and his ruling Serbian Progressive Party (SNS).

title: Mary Lincoln: “A nice, chatty little letter” Shortly Before the Assassination of her Husband
content:
On Wednesday, Feb. 15, 1865, Mary Lincoln sat down before a lined sheet of paper, which was bordered in black, marking that she was still mourning the death of her son Willie three years earlier, the second of the Lincoln children to die of a childhood illness. In tight, perfect penmanship, she dashed off a short letter to her friend Caroline Wright.

She thanked Wright for sending along a wreath of hair, advised her that the Executive Mansion (as the White House was then called) was in the midst of remodeling and thus it would be best if Wright and her husband stayed at the nearby Willard Hotel for an upcoming visit.

“We will be deprived of several charming visitors, yourselves included, on the 1rst of March,” she wrote, referring to the period around her husband’s second inauguration. “Yet … we will be happy to have you dine with us and see you frequently.”

She wrote that she was interrupted just then, must close, and signed off with kind regards as “Mary Lincoln,” the way she always did after she married.

title: How to win (and lose) an ally in 10 days
content: These past few weeks mark a more deliberate and open campaign of coercion against Europe and Ukraine by the US and Russia. Both US president Donald Trump and Russian president Vladimir Putin have something to gain: a better result for the Republicans in the upcoming US midterm elections, a Ukraine pushed into defeat, and a Europe that still depends on the US. What happened: 9 October: Trump and Putin hold a long phone call. Afterwards, the US lifts sanctions on Russian diesel until April 2027, letting Russia sell millions of tonnes of it to the US and global markets. Historian Anne Applebaum called it “an abrupt, Hail Mary attempt to force Ukraine to surrender and to save the Russian economy.” Never mind that, according to the EU's economy chief, Russia can't export enough diesel to change prices. On the call, Putin proposes a summit with Trump and Chinese president Xi Jinping in China next month to decide Ukraine's future, without Ukraine. According to a Russian intelligence officer briefed on the matter, Putin wants a “second Yalta,” the 1945 conference where the US, UK, and Soviet Union carved up Europe, this time with the US, Russia, and China dividing the world between them.

title: “The River Can’t Be Trusted”
content:
Peak tourist season had arrived in Ruidoso, New Mexico, and Mayor Lynn Crawford was campaigning to convince the public that the village was safe. A Republican with white hair and a Texas drawl, Crawford said he was frustrated with residents who were sharing warnings of flooding on social media. “They spout stuff off,” he said in a radio address on June 30, 2025. “And I don’t know why they’re so afraid. I do not understand it.” 

The community had experienced severe flooding the previous summer, after two wildfires burned 25,000 acres above town, in the Sacramento Mountains. The fires and floods had destroyed about 1,000 homes. Together, the Village of Ruidoso and its smaller neighbor, Ruidoso Downs, are home to some 10,000 residents, but that number more than doubles during the summer.

Since then, residents had been on edge. A new monsoon season had arrived, bringing sporadic flooding that jeopardized the town’s economic engine of horse racing. At stake were big crowds to celebrate the Fourth of July, watch quarter horse racing and enjoy cool weather that’d lured Texans here for generations.

title: UNEP: Opportunity has ‘been lost’ to meet 1.5C warming limit without ‘overshoot’
content:
A temporary breach of the 1.5C global-warming limit is now “inevitable” following “decades of insufficient climate action”, says the UN Environment Programme (UNEP).

In its “sobering” annual assessment of the global “emissions gap”, UNEP says that exceeding the Paris Agreement’s 1.5C limit is “imminent and unavoidable”.

This year’s report, titled “The point of return”, says the “task now” is to minimise the size and scale of a temperature “overshoot” and to “establish a credible return path to 1.5C by the end of the century”.

Even the “lowest possible” overshoot scenario for 1.5C would first see global warming peak at around 1.7-1.8C in the middle of the century before declining, says the report.

This scenario – which is “still aligned with the long-term temperature goal of the Paris Agreement” – would require global emissions cuts of 18% by 2030 and 45% by 2035, while ramping up “removals” of carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere, says UNEP.

In contrast, it notes that the current climate pledges by countries around the world – even if fully implemented – would only reduce emissions by 5-8% by 2030 and 11-15 % by 2035, relative to 2025 levels.

title: BSR Policy Briefing 6/2026
content:
Miłosz Bartosiewicz, M.A., has been a research fellow and analyst at the Russian Department of the Centre for Eastern Studies (OSW) in Warsaw, Poland since 2023. His expertise focuses primarily on Russian regional policy and the Russian Federation’s policy towards countries of the Global South.

This paper aims to outline the current situation in Russia’s Northwestern Federal District — whose constituent entities border NATO states — against the backdrop of the Kremlin increasingly involving these regions in tasks related to the ongoing full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The author analyses regional developments across political, security, economic, financial, and social dimensions, while examining how the Putin regime’s policy of hyper-centralization affects its ability to leverage the authorities, resources, and populations of federal subjects to support the war effort. Although events in Russia’s Northwest largely mirror nationwide trends, the author also identifies some specific regional characteristics. The analysis draws on official Russian data, media reports (from both pro-Kremlin and independent outlets), and analytical studies, including the author’s own previous work.

title: Vietnam: Independent Trade Unions Suppressed
content:
(New York) ‒ The Vietnamese government is systematically suppressing the rights of workers to organize independent unions, Human Rights Watch said in a report released today. Despite pledges to trading partners in several free trade agreements, the government has failed to put in place meaningful reforms to enable trade unions to form and operate freely, and it routinely represses independent labor organizing. 

Hanoi’s Continuing Assault on Workers’ Right to Organize

Download the full report in English

Download the Summary & Recommendations in Vietnamese

The 49-page report, “There Are No Independent Trade Unions in Vietnam: Hanoi’s Continuing Assault on Workers’ Right to Organize,” documents the Vietnamese governments’ continuing use of vague, overbroad criminal laws to suppress the activities of human rights and labor rights defenders, while maintaining an atmosphere of repression to thwart independent labor organizing. The government has issued decrees and articles in state-run media that reaffirm that all labor organizations in Vietnam are under the government’s authority, and portray independent trade unions as dangerous, anti-state entities.

title: Sears Sold 75,000 DIY Mail Order Homes Between 1908 and 1939, and Transformed American Life
content:
Two of the books that most shaped American culture both happened to bear the nickname “The Big Book.” While the second of these, the A.A. Manual, published in 1939, changed the country with 12-Step recovery groups, the first of these, the Sears Catalog, transformed America with mass consumption, offering customers in every part of the country access to modern conveniences and retail goods of all kinds at unheard of prices. Beginning in 1908, Sears started selling entire houses, in approximately 25-ton kits transported by railroad, consisting of 30,000 pre-cut parts, plumbing and electrical fixtures, and up to 750 pounds of nails.

“In an era before commercial aviation and long-haul trucking,” Curbed marvels, “Sears, Roebuck & Co. set up an operation that would package and ship more than 400 different types of homes and buildings to anybody who had the cash and access to a catalog.”

title: Viimeiset mustikat
content:
• Etusivu

    • Blogi

    Asiantuntija, Ennakointi ja koulutus

    21.10.2026

    Seison kodinkoneliikkeen pakastinosastolla ja pohdin kiireen tuntu rinnassa, minkä laitteen ostaisin. Olen poiminut syksyn viimeiset mustikat talteen, ja edessä on kymmenen vuoden talvi. Seuraavasta sadosta ei ole mitään tietoa. Valtava, globaali päätös ilmastonmuokkauksesta on yhtäkkiä tiivistynyt yhteen pienenpieneen arjen kysymykseen: mitä teen näille mustikoille?

    En tietenkään oikeasti ollut kaupassa, vaan osallistuin tulevaisuussimulaatioon, jossa ihmiskunta oli päättänyt viilentää maapalloa suihkuttamalla stratosfääriin rikkidioksidia. Silti tämä kuviteltu hetki jäi mieleeni hämmästyttävän todentuntuisena.

    Nykyään aina, kun luen uutisia ilmastonmuokkauksesta, palaan hetkeksi pakastinosastolle ja niihin viimeisiin mustikoihin. Muistan, miltä tuntui yrittää ratkaista aivan tavallista arjen ongelmaa maailmassa, jossa ilmastonmuokkauksesta oli tullut todellisuutta.

    Pakastimesta tuli yllättäen paikka, jossa ymmärsin jotain kokemuksellisesta ennakoinnista.

title: Someone Opened a CashApp In Her Name. She Faces Years in Prison
content:
Amanda Smith answered the door one afternoon in April and came face to face with the local Sheriff’s department in upstate Pennsylvania. The officers said they had a warrant for her arrest for a crime she had allegedly committed more than a thousand miles away in Arkansas.

“I was completely confused,” Smith recalled. For one, she had never been to Arkansas. Second, the warrant was for computer fraud. By her own admission, Smith was not a very tech savvy person.

She had a feeling she was being set up. After discussing with the officers the practicalities of what was about to happen — she was allowed to get her contact lenses — they took her away in handcuffs to the local jail where she spent three nights.

The reason for Smith’s arrest, she learned later, was that a scammer had tricked someone on Facebook Marketplace into sending $1,000 to a CashApp account in her name that the scammer controlled. The scammer created the account using her Social Security number and date of birth. Smith said she has never used CashApp.

title: Could China and Russia Rescue Cuba’s Regime?
content:
The energy blockade has become the principal instrument of pressure employed by Washington against the Cuban regime. Unlike other coercive measures, restrictions on hydrocarbons directly affect the country’s ability to function and have resulted in repeated and lengthy nationwide power cuts.

The strategy became particularly significant after the overthrow and capture of Nicolás Maduro in January, which enabled the US to disrupt oil shipments from Venezuela, one of the principal sources of support for Cuba’s economy. Washington also put pressure on Mexico, which had become an increasingly important energy supplier to the island.

President Donald Trump’s January 29 executive order, which established a mechanism for imposing additional tariffs on countries supplying oil to Cuba, joined together sanctions on key sectors of the Cuban economy in a strategy intended to increase the costs of sustaining the communist regime from abroad.

But the effectiveness of the blockade depends on Washington’s ability to deter other states from providing Havana with the resources it needs.

title: Flamingo Revolution: Albania Protests Escalate over Corruption & Kushner/Trump Luxury Resort
content:
Student-led anti-corruption and cost-of-living protests in Albania are calling for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, among other demands. Hundreds of injuries and arrests have been reported amid a violent police crackdown, along with widespread damage to public and private property. The student demands are an outgrowth of the “Flamingo Revolution,” which erupted earlier this year in opposition to a luxury resort being developed on the ecologically sensitive Sazan Island. The planned resort is backed by Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump, President Trump’s son-in-law and daughter, and has been fast-tracked by the Rama government.

“Students find no future in Albania,” says Bora Mema, a founding member of the left-wing political party Lëvizja Bashkë, about the motivations behind the burgeoning pro-democracy movement. “Many of us have to migrate because the only development model that the government proposes is to clean the toilets of the rich and the mafia in luxurious resorts, like the one that Trump and Kushner and the national oligarchs and mafia in Albania are constructing.”

title: France’s ‘casseurs’: why the term fails to do justice to the extent of looting and spiralling unrest
content:
Following widespread looting sprees and acts of violence occurring on the sidelines of the October 17 student protests, so-called “casseurs” seem to be the centre of attention. But the term, which comes from the French verb casser or “to break”, poses more questions than answers. The sociologist Paolo Stuppia examines the unprecedented situation many cities across France are having to contend with, and the complex combination of collective action whose motivations are unclear and the social media’s extreme agility.

The Conversation: How unprecedented are the scenes of looting that we witnessed on the sidelines of the October 17 demonstrations?

Paolo Stuppia: What may be unprecedented is the extent of the destruction of private property and the goods that have been stolen. It should be clear, however, that not all the looters can necessarily be sorted into identifiable groups, at least politically.

title: Interoperability vs. Security: Why not both?
content:
An open internet where people can freely build, share, and remix each other's work is a powerful engine of grassroots innovation we’ve all benefited from. In recent decades, however, corporations have taken control of an increasing share of this work, giving them a greater ability to stifle challengers and limit our choices. When regulators address this by mandating that  tech giants play fair by requiring interoperability, the gatekeepers respond with a tired refrain: Playing fair puts users’ security at risk.

Unfortunately for these trillion-dollar companies, this gotcha isn’t the end of the conversation. Regulators can ensure that meaningful choice and security thrive.

Lawmakers have been catching up, recognizing that the best way to rein in big tech is to require these oligopolies to open up their platforms to independent developers. As we explained six years ago, mandating interoperability helps prevent the misuse of people’s data and enables more privacy-respecting alternatives. Tech giants, in contrast, have been arguing that our data is safer when they have exclusive control.

title: Good news, the robots trying to take your job are bad at it
content: A supermarket on the outskirts of Copenhagen has become the unlikely site of a futuristic labour experiment. Føtex is training humanoid robots to restock its shelves at night, a task it estimates currently takes 40-50% of its staff's time. One day, they hope to have two high-tech assistants in every store, not to replace employees but to speed up routine tasks, they say. But for now, the robots aren't exactly autonomous – trainers from the Danish start-up HIVE Robots still guide their every movement using VR goggles. Nor are they... good. Still much slower than humans, they're meant to improve as they accumulate and process data over time. Despite their awesome looks, even the most advanced humanoid robots have had some spectacular public mishaps recently, including face-planting during demonstrations. Stanford University’s 2026 AI Index Report estimated the top AI robotic systems could only complete 12% of household tasks when tested in realistic simulations. Part of the problem is hardware: rigid joints, tough materials, and limited sensors make movements stiff. title: Zelenskyi: Rintamalinja jäihin – se olisi oikea tapa lopettaa sota

title: Town Leaders Said They Were Prepared for Floods. First Responders Disagree.
content:
The man was nearly to his waist in a flooded river and couldn’t get out. A firefighter and a police officer didn’t have enough rope or manpower to lift him onto the temporary flood barrier that separated them from the debris-strewn water. The man, Jere Stark, had just been carried a quarter mile by a torrential flood and was covered in mud and extremely cold.

It was around 3:30 p.m. on July 8, 2025, and a flood in Ruidoso, New Mexico, had unleashed chaos at Paradise Canyon Drive, just a couple hundred yards from the headquarters of the village fire department.

Not far from Stark, a woman huddled on the ground, shielded from the floodwaters by the temporary barrier. It was Stephanie Trotter, a tourist from El Paso, Texas, who had been washed away with her young daughter. A civilian tended to her while a second firefighter hauled in a rope he had used to rescue her. “Is somebody coming for her?” asked the civilian.

title: IMILI and Wikimedia Nigeria Partner to Advance Media and Information Literacy, Information Integrity, and Open Knowledge in Nigeria
content:
How a connection facilitated by the Wikimedia Foundation’s Advocacy team opened the door to a partnership with the International Media and Information Literacy Institute (IMILI), a UNESCO Category 2 Institute with an international mandate.

Sometimes, an important partnership begins with a simple introduction.

For Wikimedia UG Nigeria, that introduction came through Costanza Caniglia of the Wikimedia Foundation’s Advocacy team. What began as an opportunity to connect with a contact within the United Nations system gradually grew into a series of institutional engagements, new relationships, and conversations about how the Wikimedia Movement could contribute to broader efforts to improve information literacy and access to knowledge.

Those conversations eventually led to a major milestone.

title: Supreme Court Upholds Manouchehr Fallah’s Death Sentence Again
content:
According to HRANA, citing Emtedad, the Supreme Court has upheld the death sentence issued against Manouchehr Fallah.

Fallah’s death sentence, which was reissued in June 2026 by Branch 1 of the Rasht Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Ahmad Darvish Goftar, has been upheld by the Supreme Court. According to the report, the political prisoner’s case has been referred to the Criminal Sentence Enforcement Unit in Rasht for implementation of the sentence.

In February 2025, Manouchehr Fallah was sentenced to death by Branch 2 of the Rasht Revolutionary Court on the charge of moharebeh (enmity against God). The sentence was reportedly upheld by the Supreme Court in November of the same year. However, following the acceptance of a request for retrial, the Supreme Court overturned the ruling and referred the case to Branch 1 of the Rasht Revolutionary Court for reconsideration.

title: ‘The audience gets to be in on it’: How narrative-led gameplay is Call of Duty’s greatest weapon
content:
As video games chase spectacle, Modern Warfare 4 makes a case for putting character and consequence at the heart of its biggest battles

• Don’t get Pushing Buttons delivered to your inbox? Sign up here

In these strange, subdued weeks before the much-anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto VI, there have still been some welcome surprises. Onimusha: Way of the Sword revived a half-forgotten samurai action series with much aplomb, while Silent Hill: Townfall transported all of the franchise’s bloody, dread-filled psychological horror to … the picturesque Scottish coast. Even more shocking to games writers, though, is the fact that the forthcoming Modern Warfare 4 has one of the best Call of Duty campaign modes for at least six years – and might even be up there with the original Modern Warfare trilogy.

title: EFF to Brazil’s ANPD: Data Privacy and Free Expression Must Underpin Platform Regulations
content:
The Brazilian National Data Protection Agency (ANPD) plays a pivotal role in the regulation of digital platforms according to new legislation approved in Brazil. Throughout this year, EFF has presented comments, filed submissions, and met with the agency to emphasize crucial guardrails that the enforcement of new regulations should ensure. 

ANPD is responsible for detailing and applying obligations set in Law n. 15.211/2025, which established rules for the protection of children and adolescents in the digital space. While some provisions establish important privacy safeguards, like prohibiting advertising based on profiling of underage users, the law created mandatory age assurance mechanisms for accessing digital products and services.

title: Priced out of Netflix
content: When Netflix raised my subscription price again to €17 per month, I paid and moved on. But it made me wonder what the same subscription costs everyone else. Netflix charges different prices in different countries, depending on local purchasing power. After all, not everyone can afford the €25 a month the Swiss pay. I found that Netflix's lower pricing in poorer countries is still far smaller than the gap in wages to richer countries. So while the average Dane earns their monthly subscription in the time it takes to watch an episode of Friends, the average Ukrainian has to work through the whole of Pulp Fiction.

title: JHL: Nyt riitti – Parkkipaten työntekijät lakkoon
content:
Ammattiliitto JHL ryhtyy lakkoon Parkkipate-yhtiössä.

Ellei sopimusta synny sitä ennen, lakko alkaa 5. marraskuuta ja päättyy 9. marraskuuta.

JHL kertoo tiedotteessaan, että yhtiössä ei ole voimassa olevaa työehtosopimusta eikä yhtiö suostu neuvottelemaan sen solmimisesta.

– Bisnesmallia ei voi rakentaa palkkojen polkemiselle ja työntekijöiden epävarmuudelle. Olemme valmiita neuvotteluun pikaisella aikataululla. Nyt joudumme lakkoon, koska työnantajalla ei ole minkäänlaista neuvotteluhalua, JHL:n toimialajohtaja Mari Keturi kommentoi tiedotteessa.

JHL:n mukaan yhtiö on jo aiemmin syksyllä ilmoittanut nostavansa työntekijöidensä palkkoja, mutta liiton mukaan korotukset eivät koske kaikkia työntekijöitä. Yhtiö ei myöskään maksa erilaisia haittalisiä, JHL arvostelee.

– Tämä on enemmän työnantajan paniikkireaktio tilanteeseen kuin aitoa neuvotteluhalua. Työehtosopimusten avulla työehtoja ja palkkoja kehitetään pitkäjänteisesti, ei vain kerran vuosikymmenessä.

Yhtiön verkkosivuilla Parkkipate kertoo olevansa valtakunnallisesti toimiva pysäköintiratkaisujen tuottaja, jonka asiakaskuntaan kuuluu muun muassa hotelleja, sairaaloita, kauppakeskuksia ja liikekiinteistöjä.

title: The Secret Terms of Trump’s Venezuelan Oil Deal
content:
In late August, President Donald Trump announced what he called the “biggest oil deal in world history.” Since then, the full text of the accord — which grants the U.S. sweeping access to Venezuela’s oil reserves — has been one of the most sought-after secrets in Washington, D.C. 

ProPublica has reviewed a copy of the 18-page strategic partnership agreement signed for the United States by Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The document reveals carefully constructed terms that favor U.S. interests at every turn and cements the power of a small group of people handpicked by the Trump administration to govern and profit from the deal. The role of the Venezuelan government and the potential benefits to its people are largely absent from the text.

One of the most criticized aspects of Trump’s announcement has been his choice of a partner: Alejandro Betancourt, a globe-trotting Venezuelan oligarch who has faced money-laundering investigations in three countries.

title: Lessons from Accra: Rossouw van Rooyen’s take on what the first Language Diversity Conference meant for Africa’s languages
content:
Early in the first Language Diversity Conference, Rossouw van Rooyen thought about a quote he had first heard eight years earlier.

At Wikimania 2018 in Cape Town, Daniel Bögre Udell of Wikitongues quoted Richard Henry Pratt. Pratt founded the Carlisle Indian Industrial School, a notorious US boarding school for Native American children, and summed up its mission as “kill the Indian in him, and save the man”. Seeing Daniel again in Accra set the tone for Rossouw’s weekend.

“There are languages being eradicated, there are languages being suppressed all over the world which we need to save,” he says. He adds that the work is “going to be a never-ending quest.”

The conference ran in Accra, Ghana, from 2 to 4 October 2026. It was hosted by the Wikimedia Language Diversity Hub, Wikitongues and Wikimedia UK, with the Dagbani Wikimedians User Group. 82 languages were represented in the room.

title: Prisoner Executed in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad
content:
According to HRANA, citing Haal Vsh, a prisoner was executed in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad.

The prisoner has been identified as Abdullah Narouei (Hashem Shavabzahi), approximately 43 years old, the father of five children. He was originally from Zahedan and resided in Mashhad.

According to the report, Abdullah Narouei was arrested by security forces at his home in Mashhad on November 3, 2023. He was subsequently sentenced to death by the Revolutionary Court of Mashhad in January 2026 on drug-related charges.

On Monday, October 19, 2026, Narouei was transferred to the quarantine ward of Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad. At dawn on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, he was executed by hanging at the prison without being granted a final visit with his family.

As of the time of this report, the execution has not been officially announced by prison authorities or other relevant institutions.

title: The best Kindles in the UK for every bookworm and budget – tested
content:
Whether you want a colour screen, somewhere to scribble notes or a child-friendly model, here’s what we recommend from Amazon’s e-reader range

• The best e-readers

From that fresh paperback smell to the wrinkles in the spine, nothing beats a real book. But if you’re sick of the space they take up in your home, or the weight they steal from your holiday luggage allowance, it might be worth considering an Amazon Kindle. It can fit thousands of weighty reads into as little as 158g, and as tech goes, it’s almost immune to the sort of pathological time-wasting features that come with modern phones and tablets.

Amazon Kindles have been available in the UK for more than 15 years, so they’re an old-school gadget at this point. But in 2024, the biggest update yet arrived: colour, which added an important extra option to the existing Kindle lineup, alongside readers for children, for note-taking and for tighter budgets.

title: The Chestnut Grove Caught in the Middle of A Years-Long Data Center Fight
content:
Near the bank of the Ohio River, a historic American chestnut grove in Mason County, West Virginia has become the epicenter of a fight against a planned 2,250 acre data center campus. Plans for the UK-based startup Nscale’s Monarch Compute Campus, with clients including Anthropic, Nvidia and Microsoft, encompass the former Clements State Nursery and the American chestnut trees still growing there. 

For thousands of years, the American chestnut tree was a staple of life. Its natural range spanned hundreds of millions of acres from Maine to Mississippi, centuries before those names existed. As many as four billion trees provided a hearty nut crop for humans and provided miraculously rot-resistant lumber for railroad ties and housing. It sustained black bears as they prepared to hibernate, fed white-tailed deer and turkey, and shed nutrient-dense leaves. The largest American chestnut trees once grew 100 feet tall and 13 feet wide and represented one-fourth of all hardwoods; a squirrel could scamper along their branches from New England to Georgia without touching the ground, as an old saying goes.

title: EFF’s State Legislative Agenda to End ALPR Mass Surveillance
content:
Police agencies across the U.S. have deployed Automated License Plate Readers (ALPRs) to capture images of passing vehicles along with time, date, and GPS coordinates. While the technology itself isn’t new (ALPRs have existed in various forms for more than 50 years, and in the U.S. since 1998), the surveillance landscape has shifted dramatically. Rapid advances in artificial intelligence and national data sharing have transformed police ALPRs into an interconnected, nationwide tracking network. It is pitched to city councils by law enforcement and private vendors like Flock Safety, Motorola Solutions (Vigilant), and Axon as an essential tool for solving violent crime.

In reality, it is an inherently dangerous infrastructure of mass surveillance.

title: Strengthening Language Communities: My Experience at the Language Diversity Conference
content:
The Language Diversity Conference took place from October 2nd to 4th under the inspiring theme “Strengthening Language Communities in the Open Knowledge Movement.” The event brought together language activists, Wikimedians, and open knowledge advocates from across the globe, creating a space to share strategies, celebrate linguistic diversity, and tackle the ongoing content divide facing indigenous languages.

I was honored to present a session titled “Unlocking the Voice: Advocacy for Indigenous Language Digitization.” My presentation focused on moving beyond theoretical language preservation to provide a practical, low-barrier roadmap for local communities.

I introduced a simple framework designed for language advocates:

1. Record: Utilizing accessible, everyday technology such as smartphones and open tools like Lingua Libre to capture oral histories, proverbs, and vocabulary directly from native speakers.

2. Respect: Ensuring full community consent, respecting cultural protocols, and treating community elders as co-creators rather than data sources.

title: Political Prisoner Kazem Alinejad Remains on Hunger Strike Amid Denial of Medical Care
content:
According to HRANA, Kazem Alinejad, a political prisoner held in Evin Prison, is now on the fifth day of his hunger strike.

Alinejad began his hunger strike on Friday, October 16, 2026, in protest against the denial of medical services, lack of access to necessary medications, and prison authorities’ disregard for his physical health. Five days after the strike began, his demands for medical care remain unmet, and he continues his hunger strike.

The political prisoner suffers from heart, lung, and kidney conditions, as well as diabetes and high blood pressure. Despite these serious health issues, he has been denied access to some of his essential medications. His insulin intake has also increased due to elevated blood sugar levels, while his repeated requests to be transferred to medical facilities outside the prison have gone unanswered.

title: EFF Launches Guide to Help Parents and Youth Protect Privacy Online
content:
SAN FRANCISCO – The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) has published “Online Privacy for Parents and Youth,” a new guide to help families protect themselves online. 

"Parents don’t need to be technology experts to help their children navigate the digital world safely” said EFF Public Interest Technology Director Babette Ngene. “At EFF, we believe in empowering families with the knowledge and confidence to make informed decisions about their digital lives. It’s about meeting families where they are and giving parents the guidance they need to have meaningful conversations with their children about digital safety, based on what works best for their families.” 

EFF launches this crucial resource as state and local governments consider enacting well-meaning but ill-advised laws that cut young people off from essential information and experiences, particularly harming vulnerable youth and marginalized groups who often find safety in supportive online communities they can't access offline. Such laws also entail age gating, which compromises the privacy of all internet users and stifles young users’ ability to learn, grow, and express themselves.
snippet: SAN FRANCISCO – The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) has published “Online Privacy for Parents and Youth,” a new guide to help families protect themselves online.
