title: Savonlinnan koululaiset tutustuivat taiteeseen ja luovuuteen Nälkälinnanmäen kulttuuritalon vierailupäivässä
content:
Savonlinnan koululaiset saivat mahdollisuuden tutustua taiteen ja kulttuurin maailmaan, kun MiunHarrastus -hanke järjesti koululaisille suunnattuja vierailuja Nälkälinnanmäen kulttuuritalolle. Tapahtuma tehtiin yhteistyössä muiden paikallisten kulttuuritoimijoiden kanssa 12.-16.10. Vierailun aikana oppilaat pääsivät tutustumaan Nälkälinnanmäen toimintaan ja sen ajankohtaiseen taidenäyttelyyn, tekemään näyttelyyn liittyviä tehtäviä, sekä osallistumaan monipuolisiin ja innostaviin työpajoihin. Vierailu oli osa koulujen Kulttuurin ja harrastamisen teemaviikkoa, jota vietettiin kaikissa kouluissamme kaupungin kulttuurin unelmavuoden henkeen.

Vierailupäivän tavoitteena oli tarjota lapsille elämyksiä ja kokeiluja kulttuurisisältöisiin harrastuksiin erilaisissa työpajoissa. Taidenäyttelyssä oppilaat pääsivät tarkastelemaan eri taiteilijoiden teoksia, tekemään tehtäviä ja keskustelemaan niiden herättämistä ajatuksista yhdessä opastajien kanssa.

title: Naispuoliset moottoripyörätaksikuskit ovat Keniassa harvinaisia, mutta lasikaton murtajia löytyy – Loice Ambani ajoi synnyttämäänkin moottoripyörällä
content:
Länsi‑Kenian Kisumussa hiekka pöllyää ja torvet soivat. Paikallisbussien henkilökunta huutelee ohikulkijoita asiakkaikseen. Pian Quinter Jodo kaartaa paikalle tottunein ottein. Olemus on varma ja rauhallinen. Hän nostaa ajolasit pipon peittämälle otsalleen ja avaa toppatakkiaan. Vasta kun katse viipyy kuljettajassa pidempään, paljastuu seikka, joka saa osan asiakkaista epäröimään. Hän on nainen, ja se on harvinaista.

Jodo ajaa moottoripyörätaksia Länsi-Kenian Kisumussa. Victorianjärven rannalla sijaitseva Kenian kolmanneksi suurin kaupunki on vesi- ja rautatieyhteyksiensä ansiosta merkittävä solmukohta. Se tietää asiakasvirtoja myös boda­boda-­moottoripyörätaksikuskeille. Bodaboda-sana tulee enlanninkielisestä border to border -ilmaisusta, sillä mopotakseilla kuskattiin aikoinaan asiakkaita ja salakuljetettiin tavaroita Kenian ja Ugandan rajojen yli.

Kisumussa arvioidaan olevan jopa 130 000 moottoripyörätaksikuskia. Valtaosa kuljettajista on miehiä. Jodo ei tunne henkilökohtaisesti toisia naiskuljettajia, mutta on kuullut, että heitä on kaupungissa muuallakin.

title: Kazakh President’s Grandnephew Donates Sport University to State Following Investigative Report
content:
Just one day after an investigation by Radio Azattyq and OCCRP, the grandnephew of Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev announced on Saturday that he is donating the Kazakh National University of Sports (KNUS) to the state.

Framing the handover as a patriotic gesture, Nurassyl Medeu stated the move was not a sale, a transfer into trust management, or a forced step, “but a gratuitous gift to my native country so that it prospers, reaches unprecedented heights, and achieves recognition at the global level.”

“Everything we created must serve our youth, our people, and our country,” he said, adding that it was a great honor to make the contribution. “If you compare KNUS to a ship, I built it to be powerful, reliable, and unbreakable.”

The unexpected announcement of Medeu followed a Friday investigation revealing Medeu to be the grandson of President Tokayev’s sister, Karlyga Izbastina, and detailing how two major educational ventures he founded received substantial state support.

title: The Dark Story Behind Edgar Allan Poe’s Most Famous Photograph, Taken Four Days After a Laudanum Overdose
content: In the Halloween season, one American writer comes to mind more often than any other: Edgar Allan Poe. That owes in large part to his famously macabre tales like “The Tell-Tale Heart,” “The Cask of Amontillado,” and “The Masque of the Red Death,” written though they may have been with barely concealed contempt for their sensation-seeking magazine readership. But it also has to do with the image of the man himself. Or rather, it has to do with one image in particular: a daguerreotype photograph taken on November 9, 1848, at a Providence studio that has inspired practically every representation of Poe in popular culture since.

title: Citing ProPublica, Lawmakers Introduce Bill to Help U.S. Citizens Sue ICE for Wrongful Detentions
content:
What Happened: A New Mexico Democrat in the House introduced a bill last week that would make it easier for U.S. citizens to sue immigration agents and the federal government over wrongful detentions and arrests.

Rep. Teresa Leger Fernández credited ProPublica’s reporting as the catalyst for the bill, the Justice for Citizens Wrongfully Detained by ICE Act. Earlier this month, we revealed that more than 500 U.S. citizens have been detained in warrantless arrests during the second Trump administration.

Leger Fernández said the legislation would roll back the protections from lawsuits that agents and the federal government currently have. It would also establish a minimum level of compensation for people who win their suits, and extend the statute of limitations for such cases.

The legislation would also take back any unspent Immigration and Customs Enforcement funding from President Donald Trump’s so-called One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

Leger Fernández’s bill was introduced with co-sponsor Rep. Bonnie Watson Coleman, a New Jersey Democrat.

    Sitran ja EVAn kyselytutkimus osoittaa, että suomalaiset suhtautuvat vihreään siirtymään kaksijakoisesti. Yhtäältä vastaajat pitävät ilmastonmuutoksen torjuntaa eurooppalaisena yhteishankkeena ja näkevät vihreässä siirtymässä myös taloudellisia mahdollisuuksia Suomelle. Toisaalta he kokevat, ettei EU:n energia- ja ilmastopolitiikka tunnista riittävästi Suomen erityisolosuhteita, ja pelkäävät tiukkojen ympäristötavoitteiden vaikutuksia eurooppalaisen teollisuuden kilpailukykyyn.

EU-tason ilmastopolitiikalle on vahva tuki, mutta kun siirrytään ilmastotavoitteista luonnonvaroihin, metsiin ja käytännön toimenpiteisiin, kansallisen liikkumatilan tarve kasvaa. Vihreä siirtymä hyväksytään, jos se näyttäytyy ilmastopoliittisesti välttämättömänä, taloudellisesti mahdollisena ja Suomen olosuhteet huomioivana.

title: Svensk innovation möter internationella affärsmöjligheter
content:
Vid mötet den 16 oktober deltog representanter för svenska storföretag och organisationer som arbetar med att främja svensk export, investeringar och innovation. Tillsammans med internationella företagsledare diskuterade de möjligheter och utmaningar inom den gröna omställningen.

Budskapet från svensk sida var tydligt: Sverige är öppet för samarbeten, investeringar och ökad handel.

Madeleine Sjöstedt, generaldirektör för Svenska institutet, betonade i sitt öppningsanförande att den gröna omställningen, hållbar tillväxt och tillgång till ny teknik kräver internationellt samarbete. Utmaningarna kan inte lösas av enskilda länder, företag eller organisationer, men de skapar samtidigt möjligheter till innovation, investeringar och nya affärer.

Genom att sammanföra beslutsfattare från olika länder med svenska företag och organisationer vill SI därför skapa kontakter som kan utvecklas till konkreta affärsmöjligheter.

title: After looting spree, France tells online resellers to crack down on traffic of stolen goods
content:
PARIS — The French government has called on leading online marketplaces such as Vinted and eBay to bar listings that include goods stolen during this weekend’s looting spree across France. 

“We expect these platforms to remove the listings in question without delay,” France’s Digital Affairs Minister Anne Le Hénanff wrote Monday in a post on X. “They will also be required to work closely with public authorities so that those reselling potentially stolen goods can be identified and prosecuted.”  

Le Hénanff and fellow cabinet members called a 7 p.m. meeting with representatives of Vinted, Amazon, eBay, Meta, and TikTok, as well as France’s leading independent reselling platform Leboncoin. 

During a government press conference earlier in the day, Minister for Small Businesses Serge Papin said officials were working on “coordination between investigators and online platforms” to identify the individuals behind suspicious listings. A specific protocol is expected to be put in place, according to a government source speaking to POLITICO.

Nuorisotyöttömyys on pitkään ollut kasvussa. Nuorten työllistymistä ja työelämään siirtymistä käsittelevässä Nuorisotutkimusseuran politiikkasuosituksessa korostetaan, että nuorten tilanteet ja tuen tarpeet vaihtelevat merkittävästi. title: John J. Audubon’s Breathtaking Book of Birds
content:
—This is a guest post by Ashley Rose Young, a curator in the Rare Book and Special Collections Division. It also appears in the September/October issues of the Library of Congress Magazine.

In the early 19th century, John James Audubon set out to do something no natural history illustrator had attempted at such scale: depict North American birds at life size, in vivid, animated poses. The result was “The Birds of America,” one of the most ambitious — and physically imposing — sets of books ever produced.

Published between 1827 and 1838, the work was issued as a series of hand-colored engravings, printed on enormous “double elephant” sheets measuring roughly 38 by 26 inches. Audubon partnered with the London engraver Robert Havell Jr. to translate his paintings into prints of remarkable precision and color.

Subscribers received the plates in installments, eventually assembling a collection that included 435 illustrations depicting 489 species of birds. All that paper adds up: Typically bound in four volumes, “The Birds of America” can be astonishingly heavy. The Library’s set totals 196 pounds, with the largest volume weighing a whopping 55 pounds.

title: Thirty years of Aleksanteri: A history of change, curiosity, and connection
content:
As the Institute celebrates its 30th anniversary, its history reveals not only how the world around it has changed, but how an academic community has grown and evolved alongside it. 

When the Aleksanteri Institute was founded in 1996, Europe was still coming to terms with the end of an era.  

Only five years had passed since the collapse of the Soviet Union. Newly independent states had emerged, political systems were being reinvented, and the future of Russia and its neighbours remained uncertain. For Finland, where developments on the other side of the eastern border have often had serious implications for the country as well, understanding these transformations was especially important.  

It was against this backdrop that the Aleksanteri Institute was established at the University of Helsinki, at the initiative of Finland's Ministry of Education. Its task was ambitious: to strengthen and coordinate Finnish research and education on Russia and Eastern Europe. This meant building capacity in the field by training doctoral and MA-level students of all Finnish universities and bringing together expertise that had previously been scattered across different universities and disciplines.

title: Muinais-DNA paljastaa keskiaikaisen muuttoliikkeen Ruotsista Suomeen
content:
Uusi tutkimus Suomen väestöhistoriasta rautakauden lopulla ja keskiajalla paljastaa vilkkaat vuorovaikutusverkostot yli Itämeren. Turun yliopiston tutkimus analysoi Lounais-Suomessa ja Hämeessä 1000–1200-luvuilla eläneiden ihmisten perimää ja selvitti, miten alueen väestö muuttui keskiajan kuluessa ja millaisia yhteyksiä ihmisillä oli Itämeren muihin alueisiin.

Tulokset paljastavat merkittävän eron rannikon ja sisämaan väestöhistoriassa. Varhaiskeskiajalla (n. 1050–1250 jaa.) Lounais-Suomen rannikon ja sisämaan asukkaat olivat geneettisesti hyvin samanlaisia, vaikka alueilla oli kulttuurisia ja taloudellisia eroja. Tämän jälkeen kehitys kulki eri suuntiin: sisämaassa säilyi geneettinen jatkuvuus nykyaikaan saakka, kun taas rannikolla väestön geneettinen koostumus muuttui keskiajan jälkeen. Ruotsista saapuneen keskiaikaisen muuttoliikkeen vuoksi länsirannikon nykyisillä suomalaisilla on enemmän skandinaavista perimää kuin samalla alueella varhaiskeskiajalla eläneillä ihmisillä.

title: Tästä on kyse Eettisen kehityssanaston oppaassa
content:
Eettisen kehityssanaston oppaan perimmäisenä tarkoituksena on herättää ajatuksia kieleen linkittyvästä eriarvoisuudesta.

Jaa

Fingon julkaisema Eettisen kehityssanaston opas on herättänyt keskustelua. Kerromme tässä blogissa tarkemmin, mistä oppaassa on kyse ja oikaisemme väärinkäsityksiä.

Eettisen kehityssanaston opas ei kiellä tai pyri kieltämään minkään termin käyttöä – mutta se sisältää suosituksia perustelujen kera.

Kyseessä on nimenomaan opas, eikä kielenkäyttöä koskeva ohje. Oppaassa todetaan: ”Tärkeintä ei ole virheetön kielenkäyttö, vaan aito pyrkimys oppia ja ymmärtää kielessä ja sen rakenteissa piileviä ongelmia.”

Oppaassa on luokiteltu termejä kolmeen kategoriaan:

  • Yhdeksän käsitettä on luokiteltu kategoriaan Lakkaamme käyttämästä, joka määritellään seuraavasti: Nämä ovat termejä, joiden käyttämistä vältämme.
  • Kymmenen termiä on luokiteltu kategoriaan Herättää kysymyksiä. Se määritellään näin: Nämä ovat termejä, jotka herättävät kriittisiä kysymyksiä, mutta joiden käyttäminen voi silti olla tarkoituksenmukaista.

title: For something to be feasible, it must be measurable! The ZenDiS Sovereignty Check
content:
German and European policymakers want us to achieve digital sovereignty. But what does that actually mean? When are we digitally sovereign, and what conditions must be met for that to happen?

The question, then, is: How do you actually measure digital sovereignty?

The Center for Digital Sovereignty in Public Administration (ZenDiS) addressed this question in the spring of 2026. To this end, ZenDiS developed a so-called “Sovereignty Check” for public administration. This check is based on clearly defined criteria across four categories, designed to make digital sovereignty measurable: –

  • Organization and Capabilities – An organization’s management and governance capabilities
  • Digital Applications and Services – the design and interchangeability of the applications used, as well as control over these applications
  • Information and Data – data ownership and data sovereignty
  • Operations and Infrastructure – technical and organizational operational sovereignty

title: Enkät: Sverigefinsk litteratur – de viktigaste verken för dig?
content:
Vilka är de viktigaste verken inom den sverigefinska litteraturen? Finlandsinstitutets bibliotek har lanserat en enkät riktad till sverigefinnar för att identifiera verk som är viktiga för minoriteten. De böcker som föreslås ska vara skrivna av författare med finsk bakgrund bosatta i Sverige. Utifrån enkäten kommer en litteraturlista att tas fram som stöd för bibliotekens beståndsarbete.

Vilka sverigefinska böcker har varit betydelsefulla för dig? Vilka verk av sverigefinska författare skildrar bäst minoritetens språk, kultur, identitet och erfarenheter i Sverige?

Finlandsinstitutets bibliotek vill ha hjälp av sverigefinnar att identifiera centrala verk inom den sverigefinska litteraturen. Vi välkomnar tips på böcker som belyser minoritetens erfarenheter och historia. Du kan föreslå till exempel romaner, noveller, dikter och facklitteratur.

Målet är att sammanställa en litteraturlista med centrala verk inom den sverigefinska litteraturen för bland annat bibliotekens användning. De förslag som samlas in genom enkäten kommer att ligga till grund för ett expertmöte där listan kompletteras med forskningsbaserad kunskap.

title: The OTR Symposium 2026: Shaping the Open Transition takes place in one week!
content:
The first Open Technology Research (OTR) Symposium – the OTR Symposium 2026: Shaping the Transition – kicks off in one week, on 26 and 27 October 2026 at the University of Barcelona. The final agenda is now confirmed: three headline sessions, 18 research presentations across five thematic tracks and an open source hardware block, a panel on Barcelona’s own open transition, and the presentation of the Basil Cousins Award.

The OTR Symposium 2026 is convened by the founding members of Open Technology Research: OpenForum Europe, the Open Source Initiative, the Open Knowledge Foundation, and the Digital Infrastructure Insights Fund. It builds on OFE’s OpenForum Academy Symposium, which ran from 2021 to 2025, and takes place as part of Barcelona Open Tech Week. The Symposium is one of several events in Barcelona Open Tech Week, alongside Mozilla Festival, Decidim Fest, the 4D Conference, the Open Source Policy Summit and the Global Assembly for Open Source.

title: Opening New Paths for Open Source
content:
Dear OSI community,

The past few weeks took me from New York to Halifax to Prague, and I came home with a full notebook and a long list of follow-ups.

At UN Digital Cooperation Day (part of the 81st UN General Assembly), I joined a panel on Open Source AI to reinforce the importance of shared language and common definitions when crafting policy. Later that day I joined Creative Commons and the NYU Engelberg Center for a conversation about openness and digital sovereignty. My key message there was simple: open by itself does very little, but enables a lot. You can read more about these talks, plus the inaugural 50-in-5 Awards, in Nick Vidal’s blog post Open Enables a Lot: The OSI at UNGA81.

My next stop was Stakeholder Day as part of Open Source Congress in Halifax. It was great to connect with leaders from more than 40 foundations as they formed working groups on global collaboration, sustainability, security, regulatory policy, AI, and governance. These are big problems, and it was encouraging to see so many organizations sign up to work on them together.

title: Where have all the British bands gone?
content: Toothbrush, check! Pyjamas, check! Visa, customs paperwork for the guitars, import tax for the band T-shirts, EU-compliant transport, oh wait... “Brexit has made everything shit and terrible,” said Eliza Lee, lead guitarist for goth-grunge band Venus Grrrls from Leeds, all of them too young to have voted in the 2016 UK referendum to leave the EU. “The things you need to make touring easy now cost an extortionate amount of money,” she told The European Correspondent. The UK exited the EU without negotiating anything to help bring people or their gear into the EU smoothly. Harsher rules, extra costs, and restrictions fall hard on touring musicians, especially smaller acts. title: Police Say Scammers Used AI to Clone a Sheriff’s Voice
content:
A Florida police department claims that scammers used AI to clone a sheriff’s voice, with scammers increasingly using voice clones that trick people into thinking they’ve missed jury duty or have a warrant out for their arrest are increasing.

According to Florida news outlet News6, scammers cloned Osceola County Sheriff Steve Moser’s voice and left a voicemail with a resident.    

“They cloned his voice and was using Steve’s picture as well to say it was him making the phone call, and it was not,” Sheriff Chris Blackmon told News6.

Impersonating a police officer is a third-degree felony in Florida. The Osceola County sheriff’s office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

This particular scam cloning cops is spreading across several states, with reports of jury duty and arrest warrant scams targeting people in Georgia and Pennsylvania in the last week. These other reports don’t mention AI voice cloning explicitly, but note that the scammers sometimes have similar voices and tones as local police officers.

title: Human Rights Education Resources for Write for Rights 2026
content:
Every year around 10 December – Human Rights Day – Amnesty International’s Write for Rights campaign brings millions of people together to stand in solidarity with individuals and communities facing human rights violations.

Around the world, people write letters, sign petitions, create artwork, learn together, and take action to demand justice. Year after year, these collective actions have helped change lives, showing that borders are no barrier to solidarity and that words have the power to inspire hope and drive change.

Human rights education is a central part of that movement. Alongside taking action, people come together to understand the issues behind each Individual at Risk case, reflect on why human rights matter and explore how solidarity can help protect them.

The Write for Rights 2026 Human Rights Education resources help teachers, educators and facilitators engage learners in meaningful learning about human rights and support them to take informed action.

title: It’s the Networks, Stupid
content:
It took Reform leader Nigel Farage less than 12 hours following Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s maiden speech at September’s UN General Assembly to falsely claim the UK’s new National Centre for Information Defence (NCID) would be a “Ministry of Truth to clamp down on free speech.”

Given that the scope and powers of NCID have yet to be determined, Farage’s comments had no evidential basis.

Burnham spoke of a center that would “detect, attribute and disrupt” hostile state attacks and an organization that would “support and defend our democracy.” The prime minister and officials who have worked on this announcement and will shape the eventual center should be congratulated on this move and supported in their efforts.

The “chiefs” tasked with shaping the center now have decisions to make in terms of the scope, scale, and priorities of NCID.

What are the key considerations?

Firstly, NCID will not decide what Britons are allowed to say. Genuine speech of any kind, along with domestic information manipulation activity (DIM), should not be within its scope.

title: Masked Israeli Settlers Nearly Kill Washington Post Journalist as Attacks on Palestinians Escalate
content: Israeli settlers backed by IDF soldiers brutally assaulted Palestinian olive farmers in the village of Abu Falah, northeast of Ramallah, on Friday. Witnesses say dozens of masked Israeli settlers armed with clubs, sticks, slingshots and guns hurled rocks at Palestinian farmers, set olive trees ablaze and drove people from their fields. Veteran Washington Post photojournalist Heidi Levine, a 64-year-old American, was documenting the attack when settlers began beating her. She suffered stab wounds, a broken rib, four broken vertebrae and a severe hand injury. Levine was wearing a clearly marked press vest and a helmet at the time of the attack. According to the Israeli human rights group Yesh Din, Israeli settlers have carried out at least 170 attacks against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank since September 27, which marked the start of this year’s olive harvest.

title: KD-nuoret suuttuivat Mika Ebelingin Venäjä-mielistelystä: ”Peru puheesi”
content:
Kristillisdemokraattien nuorisojärjestö paheksuu puolueen helsinkiläisen kansanedustajaehdokkaan Mika Ebelingin Ukraina-väitteitä ja vaatii tätä perumaan Venäjää tukevat puheensa.

Ebeling on julistanut syksyn aikana sosiaalisessa mediassa, että lännen pitäisi lopettaa Ukrainan tukeminen ja maan ”tuhoaminen” sotatoimien jatkamisella.

Helsingin Sanomien kysyessä asiasta Ebeling korosti, että lännen pitää huomioida Venäjän turvallisuusedut, ja patistaa Ukraina rauhaan ennen kuin Venäjä tuhoaa sotilasmahdillaan koko maan.

Ebeling myös arvioi, että Venäjä olisi perunut hyökkäyksensä Ukrainaan, jos länsi olisi myöntynyt Kremlin vaatimuksiin ennen vuotta 2022.

NUORISOJÄRJESTÖ sanoo maanantaina julkaisemassaan kannanotossa Ebelingin esittämiä näkemyksiä paikkansapitämättömiksi.

KD Nuoret muistuttaa, että puolue on ottanut voimakkaasti kantaa Ukrainan tukemisen puolesta ja kannattaa Suomen valtiojohdon linjaa Venäjän aggression torjumisessa.

– Olemme täysin eri mieltä Ebelingin kanssa Ukrainan sodasta ja Naton toiminnasta, ja toivomme että hän korjaisi virheellisiä lausuntojaan, KD Nuorten puheenjohtaja Toni Haakila Costa sanoo Demokraatille.

title: Homayoun Shabankareh Sentenced to Death
content:
Based on information received by HRANA, Homayoun Shabankareh was sentenced to death by Branch 2 of the Karaj Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Mehdi Sabzevarnejad (Sabzevari).

An informed source close to the family of Shabankareh, who is currently held at Karaj Central Penitentiary, confirmed the news to HRANA, stating: “Homayoun Shabankareh’s death sentence was issued on charges of moharebeh and espionage and was officially communicated to him on Saturday, October 17, 2026. Another judge involved in the case is Mehdi Razavi.”

Shabankareh was arrested at his home by security forces on May 14, 2026, in connection with the military conflict and subsequently transferred to Karaj Central Penitentiary. During his arrest, security agents searched his residence for three hours and confiscated several personal belongings, including his laptop.

title: Lebanon: Amend Media Law to Protect Free Expression
content:
(Beirut) – Lebanon’s parliament should amend the recently-adopted media law to fully remove all provisions in Lebanese law that restrict the right to free expression, Human Rights Watch said today. Parliament passed the law on August 11, 2026, but a new draft law introduced by 10 members of parliament on October 5 offers amendments to the law that would resolve its key problematic provisions.

“Given the history of public officials and powerful individuals abusing Lebanon’s laws to clamp down on journalists, activists, and artists, parliament should act to prevent further abuse,” said Ramzi Kaiss, Lebanon researcher at Human Rights Watch. “No one should face abusive retaliation for peacefully expressing their views, and parliament has a chance to end these abuses right here and now.”

title: Five Questions About What’s Behind Nigeria’s Romance Scam Industry
content:
In February, OCCRP tracked down a 31-year-old man to his mansion in Nigeria’s capital Abuja. He had allegedly posed as the Crown Prince of Dubai to con a Romanian businesswoman out of more than $2.5 million in a romance scam, according to his victim and two accomplices. 

This is a well-trodden profession in Nigeria, where large numbers of young men, often facing extreme poverty, have taken to swindling lonely victims in wealthier countries to fill their pockets.  

Yet most of the romance scams originating in Nigeria are not particularly complex or lucrative, says journalist Carlos Barragán.

His recently published book, “The Yahoo Boys,” explores what drives the country's teenage fraudsters — whose nickname comes from the Yahoo email addresses used for “Nigerian prince” scams in the early days of the internet — and the repercussions of their scams in Nigeria and abroad.

title: When a Cat Co-Authored a Paper in a Leading Physics Journal (1975)
content:
Back in 1975, Jack H. Hetherington, a physics professor at Michigan State University, wrote a research paper on low–temperature physics for the respected scientific journal Physical Review Letters. Before sending it off, Hetherington asked a colleague to review the paper, just to make sure it covered the right bases. What happened next Hetherington explained in the 1982 book, More Random Walks in Science:

Before I submitted [the article], I asked a colleague to read it over and he said, ‘It’s a fine paper, but they’ll send it right back.’ He explained that that is because of the Editor’s rule that the word “we” should not be used in a paper with only a single author. Changing the paper to the impersonal seemed too difficult now, and it was all written and typed; therefore, after an evening’s thought, I simply asked the secretary to change the title page to include the name of the family cat, a Siamese called Chester, sired one summer by Willard (one of the few unfixed male Siamese cats in Aspen, Colorado). I added the initials F D in front of the name to stand for Felix Domesticus and thus created F D C Willard.

title: He Tried to Set Limits on His State’s School Vouchers. Billionaires Helped Bankroll a Campaign to Unseat Him.
content:
On a cold February morning at West Virginia’s Capitol, children in winter jackets, holding signs and their homework, clogged the hallways outside the House Finance Committee room. Delegate Vernon Criss, the committee’s chairperson, popped outside his office, then promptly walked back in. 

Five days earlier, the Republican lawmaker had proposed to limit payouts from a voucher program that diverts public tax dollars to private education. Since then, families had shown up each morning, and with them lobbyists and organizers posting inflammatory assertions that the proposal would kill the program.

Criss didn’t want that. Five years earlier, he voted to create the Hope Scholarship program, the nation’s first educational savings account program to have no income requirements. Since then, 11 other states have passed similar legislation.

title: France riots: Presidential hopeful Attal pitches social media blackout
content:
French presidential candidate Gabriel Attal reiterated his call to grant the government power to selectively block access to social media platforms to quell riots in the aftermath of widespread unrest across France over the weekend.

“You have young people at home who see their friends going out to loot, which gives the impression that they’re getting away with it; they see them on social media, and then they go out too,” Attal said in an interview with French radio station RTL.

Attal, a former prime minister who now leads French President Emmanuel Macron’s political party, said the measures must be “temporary” and “limited to the area where the riots are taking place.”

Saturday saw hundreds of thousands of protesters take to the streets nationwide across France, with students — who have been blockading schools in recent weeks to call for better study conditions, more teachers and more funding — joining trade unions and members of the public to protest the cost of living. While many protested peacefully, scenes of extreme violence also played out across the country. According to the latest figures from the interior ministry, some 2,000 people were arrested during the turmoil.

title: As French protests escalate into riots, they may prove a gift for Marine Le Pen’s right-wing party
content:
Mass protests in France have spiralled into riots, with between 500,000 and 800,000 demonstrators in cities and towns across the country, most of them students. More than 100 police and many more protesters have been injured and up to 2,000 people have so far been arrested.

Major public buildings – such as the town hall in Limoges and the historic tourist office in Lyon – were destroyed, while other public buildings were damaged and hundreds of shops were looted by small groups of mainly young men.

The protests began in the working-class suburb of Créteil in southeastern Paris on September 21 when high school students demonstrated against poor conditions: dilapidated facilities, a shortage of teachers and inconvenient timetabling (schools in France often spread classes between 8am and 6pm, including Saturday mornings, leaving one clear afternoon).

This summer’s heatwaves were still being felt in September in classrooms with no cooling systems. Senior school students have been further frustrated by the inefficiencies and inequities of the Parcoursup university application online portal.

title: Mitä valintoja tutkija tekee? – Jaana Vuoren uusi tiedeteos avaa empiiristä tutkimusta ihmistieteissä
content:
Sukupuolentutkimuksen professori emerita Jaana Vuoren uusi teos Johdatus empiiriseen tutkimukseen ihmistieteissä on kirjoitettu ensimmäiseksi korkeakoulutasoiseksi tutkimusmenetelmiä käsitteleväksi oppikirjaksi ihmistieteissä. Niitä ovat humanistiset ja yhteiskuntatieteet sekä monet tieteidenväliset alat.

Teos toimii myös käsikirjana pitemmälle ehtineille opiskelijoille ja tutkijoille sekä antaa virikkeitä menetelmien opettajille.

”Kirja on rakennettu tutkimusasetelman käsitteen varaan, sillä jokainen tutkimuksen tekijä ratkaisee siihen liittyviä kysymyksiä”, Jaana Vuori sanoo.

Mitä kaikkea voi käyttää aineistona? Millaista toimintaa on analysoiminen? Miksi tutkimuksen ytimessä on tutkimusongelma ja miten sellaisen voi keksiä? Miten ymmärtää teorian rooli analyysin ohjaajana? Miten päästä analyysin kautta tuloksiin ja tulkintoihin?

”Kirja tarjoaa näkökulmia ennen muuta siihen, millaisia valintoja tutkijat tekevät, jotta tutkimuksesta tulisi tuloksia ja tulosten pohjalta voitaisiin lisätä tietoa ympäröivästä maailmasta, ihmisten toiminnasta, yhteiskunnasta ja kulttuurista”, Jaana Vuori lisää.

title: Kaisanetin Valokuitu laajakaistapalvelulle on myönnetty Avainlippumerkki
content:
Suomalainen työ ry:n myöntämä Avainlippu-palvelumerkki kertoo, että Kaisanetin Valokuitu laajakaistapalvelu on kotimaisesti omistetun yrityksen Suomessa tuottama palvelu.

Avainlippu on merkki suomalaisesta työstä. Merkin myöntämisen ensisijaisena kriteerinä on aina se, että tuote on valmistettu tai palvelu on tuotettu Suomessa. Lisäksi suomalaisten kustannusten osuus palvelun omakustannusarvosta, eli palvelun kotimaisuusasteen, on oltava vähintään 50 prosenttia. Palvelu-Avainlippua hakevalla yrityksellä on myös oltava merkittävä kotimainen omistusosuus, Suomessa toimiva johto ja yrityksen pääkonttorin tulee sijaita Suomessa.

Avainlippu-merkki on myönnetty Kaisanetin Valokuitu laajakaistapalveluille. Palvelukokonaisuus kattaa suunnittelun ja rakentamisen, asennuksen, myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja hallinnon.

title: What can a glowing fibre tell us about a medieval document?
content:
Medieval charters are more than written records. They are physical objects, carefully produced and preserved, with materials that can tell us much about the people and practices behind them. In CHARM, we also have charters that have seals attached to them with parchment strips or cords. The attachment, with the seal, helped to authenticate documents and give them authority.

But what were these threads made of? Were they linen, silk, or another fibre? And how were their colours produced?

As part of the CHARM project, we are investigating the fibres used to attach seals to medieval Finnish charters, to see if they can provide a useful additional proxy in our project.

title: Virta: Hallitus murentaa oikeusvaltiota – syyttäjälaitoksen leikkaukset pysäytettävä
content:
Vihreiden puheenjohtaja Sofia Virta vaatii hallitusta perumaan oikeudenhoidon leikkaukset ja turvaamaan syyttäjälaitoksen resurssit. Hallituksen esitys pidentäisi syyteharkinta-aikaa ja kasvattaisi avoimien asioiden määrää.

Virran mukaan oikeus ei saa jäädä toteutumatta ruuhkien takia.

”Oikeusvaltio ei ole vain sitä, että meillä on riippumattomat tuomioistuimet ja laissa turvatut oikeudet. Oikeusvaltio tarkoittaa myös sitä, että rikokset tutkitaan, syytteet käsitellään ja ihmiset saavat asiansa ratkaistuksi kohtuullisessa ajassa. Jos rikoksen uhri tai rikoksesta epäilty joutuu odottamaan oikeutta vuosikausia, oikeusturva ei toteudu niin kuin sen pitäisi”, Virta sanoo vihreiden tiedotteessa.

Syyttäjälaitoksen tilanne on jo nyt vakava. Hallituksen omassa vuoden 2027 talousarvioesityksessä keskimääräiseksi syyteharkinta-ajaksi on kirjattu 5,6 kuukautta, kun vuonna 2025 se oli 2,7 kuukautta. Samalla avoimien asioiden määrän arvioidaan kasvavan noin 28 000:sta yli 45 000:een.

title: New website reflects OSI’s evolving mission
content:
Over the years, OSI’s work has expanded beyond the Open Source Definition and licensing to encompass policy and standards, research and education, and Open Source AI. The new website brings these areas into clearer focus, making it easier for the community and our partners to discover what we do and find ways to get involved.

The new website architecture organizes OSI’s work around its major strategic areas: Licensing, Open Source AI, Policy & Standards, Research & Education, and Community.

One of the most significant changes is elevating Policy & Standards to a primary navigation category. This will make our policy positions, regulatory engagement, and work across regions and topics easier to find.

We’re also expanding the visibility of Research & Education initiatives, including our work with the Open Technology Research (OTR) Network and the development of the Open Source Licensing Education hub.

Finally, under Community, we are creating dedicated pathways for different audiences, including maintainers and developers, lawyers and legal professionals, founders and executives, nonprofits and academia, and policymakers and government.

title: Your fries are getting shorter (but no less crispy)
content: No matter what the weather did to this year's harvest, Belgium will still deliver its biggest contribution to the culinary cultural canon: fries. They will still taste good. But this season, the long ones may be missing from your paper cone. First came the potato glut. Last year’s harvest was so abundant that potatoes sold without a contract went for between €0 and €5 per 100 kg – far below production costs, said Daniel Ryckmans, an agronomist at the Walloon potato organisation FIWAP. For this season, the sector asked farmers to plant less, and they did: Belgium's potato fields shrank by 17.4%. Then the summer came, and multiple extreme heatwaves came with it. “This year there was not enough rain. And above that, it was too hot,” Ryckmans told us. The result of this combination is fewer, smaller potatoes. A September assessment by the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit (ECIU), a non-profit organisation based in the UK, put Belgian yields 21% below their five-year average. title: Deepening Black Sea Crisis Demands US Involvement
content:
Something very serious is happening in the Black Sea, and it demands a response. Merchant ships are being attacked and sunk without warning in the latest, highly provocative action in Russia’s shadow war against European NATO members.

A slew of drone attacks on merchant vessels off the coasts of Romania and Bulgaria, attributed to Russia, have killed at least two sailors and left 21 missing. On October 5, a Turkish cargo ship hit by drones sank in Romania’s exclusive economic zone. The following week, two chemical tankers were set ablaze, one just inside and one just outside Romanian territorial waters. A total of seven ships have been hit. Romania responded on October 17 by shooting down two drones identified as jet-powered Russian Geran 4s, which were headed westward toward the country.

Some of the vessels were engaged in trade with Ukraine, but several were not, suggesting that the Kremlin’s attacks served a wider and more worrying purpose.

title: French Gov't Cracks Down on Mass Protests over Cost of Living, Education Cuts; 2,400+ Arrested
content:
Hundreds of thousands of protesters marched in over 140 cities across France on Saturday, demanding relief from the high cost of living, more funding for public services and improvements to deteriorating schools, among other grievances. The demonstrations were the latest — and largest — in a series of protests that began in September with high schooler-led demonstrations against overcrowded classrooms and crumbling school infrastructure. Some cities saw property destruction, arson and theft on Saturday, with city halls and other symbols of the state coming under attack. Officials said nearly 1,000 police officers were injured and some 2,400 people were arrested.

“What is frustrating to see is how little the police violence is addressed and talked about, which is really the main violence and the real violence today that is taking place in France,” says Rayyan Seriket, a member of the French student union.

“We’re talking about shattered jaws, high schoolers and adolescents who have been blinded,” adds Harrison Stetler, an independent journalist and teacher based in Paris.

title: Espoo ja Vantaa irtisanovat kymmeniä – Vantaan SDP: Taloutta ei saa tasapainottaa lasten tai henkilöstön hyvinvoinnin kustannuksella
content:
Espoo ja Vantaa kertoivat maanantaina kymmenien ihmisten irtisanomisista ja töiden uudelleenjärjestelyistä yhteistoimintaneuvotteluiden päätteeksi.

Espoossa kaupungin koko henkilöstöä koskeneet yt-neuvottelut päättyivät viime viikolla erimielisinä. Työnantaja arvioi vähennystarpeeksi nyt 140 henkilötyövuotta, kun vielä elokuussa arvio oli 250.

Irtisanominen kohdistuisi 80 ihmiseen ja 60 tehtävää saatetaan lakkauttaa esimerkiksi eläköitymisten kautta.

Vantaalla työnantaja arvioi irtisanomisten kohdistuvan noin 120 ihmiseen. 80:lle tarjottaisiin uutta tehtävää irtisanomisen vaihtoehtona. Vantaan kaupunginhallitus hyväksyi maanantaina neuvottelutuloksen ensi vuoden talousarvion pohjaksi.

Molemmat kaupungit tavoittelevat noin 10 miljoonan euron säästöjä. Osa muutoksista toteutetaan muuttamalla palvelussuhteiden ehtoja ja lakkauttamalla määräaikaisten tehtäviä määräaikojen päätteeksi.

VANTAAN sosialidemokraattien kaupunginhallitusryhmä pitää myönteisenä, että suunniteltujen irtisanomisten määrä pieneni neuvotteluissa. Ryhmä korostaa kannanotossaan, ettei kaupungin talouden tasapainottaminen saa tapahtua lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin tai henkilöstön jaksamisen kustannuksella.

title: EFF Launches Privacy Badger for Safari on macOS
content:
SAN FRANCISCO—Privacy Badger, the award-winning tracker blocker made by the member-supported digital rights nonprofit Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF), is now available for Safari on macOS.  

Safari users can download the free browser extension today and join the more than 4 million people using Privacy Badger to take a stand against data brokers and online surveillance. Users will need Safari version 26.5 or higher to use it.

Ranked as one of the best ad tracker blockers by The Wirecutter, Consumer Reports, PC Mag and more, Privacy Badger is different from other blocking extensions. Created by EFF to stop companies from spying on you online, Privacy Badger automatically learns to block hidden trackers on the web, along with additional privacy-protecting features.

title: Roll Call for Freedom: A Ceremony Honoring Political Prisoners
content:
Register 


Around the world, journalists, civic leaders, artists, religious figures, and others are imprisoned for exercising fundamental freedoms. Behind every name is a person whose imprisonment has separated families, silenced vital voices, and deprived communities of courageous leadership.

To mark the International Day of Political Prisoners, Freedom House, the October 30 Coalition, and the National Endowment for Democracy invite the public to gather at the Lincoln Memorial for a ceremony honoring political prisoners and those working for their freedom.

During the event, participants will read the names of prisoners from countries across the world, ensuring that their stories are heard in the heart of the nation’s capital.

The ceremony will also recognize those released during the past year and remember those who died in forced detention. It will conclude with a joint call for free people everywhere to defend the rights of political prisoners, press for their release, and support their families.

title: EU, Belgium, Denmark: Raise Rights With Vietnam’s Leader
content:
(Brussels) – Leaders of the European Union, Belgium, and Denmark should urge Vietnam to make concrete progress in improving its human rights record during Vietnamese President To Lam’s visit to Copenhagen and Brussels the week of October 19-24, 2026, Human Rights Watch said today.

Human Rights Watch wrote to the prime ministers of Denmark and Belgium and, jointly with other groups, to the European Council and European Commission presidents, expressing concerns about Vietnam’s intensifying crackdown on human rights, which violates several obligations and commitments it made to the EU in a 2020 free trade agreement.

“The Vietnamese government has broken its pledges of reform and continues to crack down on basic freedoms,” said Patricia Gossman, senior associate Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “European leaders should communicate clearly and publicly to President To Lam that human rights and labor rights violations will no longer be tolerated.”

title: Kirjastoautovartti: Vaasan kirjastoauto Hilda
content:
Vaasan kirjastoauto Hilda vihittiin käyttöön 5.4.2025. Kirjastovirkailijat Karoliina Honkaniemi ja Annika Söderlund sekä kuljettaja Päivi Niemi kertovat Hildasta, sen kokoelmista, henkilökunnasta ja käytännön arjesta. Uusi auto on tuonut uusia asiakkaita ja kasvattanut lainamääriä, ja se on saanut paljon medianäkyvyyttä. Hildaa pyydetään usein myös mukaan erilaisiin tapahtumiin. Puhujat antavat lisäksi vinkkejä kirjastoautoa tilaaville, esimerkiksi tukikaiteista ja asiakaspalvelupisteen sijainnista. Esitys pidettiin AKE Vaasan järjestämässä Kirjastoautovartissa Teamsissa 9.10.2026.

Esityksessä kuullaan myös Vaasan kirjastoautotoiminnan historiasta, joka alkoi vuonna 1967. Hilda on Vaasan kuudes kirjastoauto. Autossa on muun muassa invahissi, vessa, jääkaappi ja pakastin sekä kattoikkunat ja väriä vaihtavat led-valot. Kokoelmiin kuuluu lähes yhtä paljon suomen- ja ruotsinkielistä aineistoa, ja aineistoa on myös muilla kielillä. Reitillä on noin 90 pysäkkiä, joihin kuuluu päiväkoteja, kouluja ja asuinalueita.

content:

Seuraavana keväänä produktion suunnitteluvaihe oli jo käynnistynyt. Opiskelukaverit olivat alun alkaen samalla sivulla siitä, että monologi tehtäisiin devising -työtavalla, jossa teoksen materiaali kerättäisiin ja luotaisiin itse. title: Ken Paxton’s Anti-Abortion Influence Already Extended Beyond Texas. He Could Take It Further in the Senate.
content:
Early in his tenure as Texas attorney general, Ken Paxton issued a statement commemorating what he believed was a national tragedy.

“It’s impossible to fill the void of more than 50 million missing human beings,” he said in 2016. He was marking the 43rd anniversary of Roe v. Wade, the Supreme Court ruling that protected abortion rights — and had long stood in the way of efforts to ban terminations in early pregnancy, when most abortions occur.

Paxton spent the years that followed testing Roe’s limits and ultimately prevailed where others had failed: In 2021, he defended a near-total abortion ban that Texas legislators had designed to evade conventional legal challenges. The U.S. Supreme Court allowed it to take effect while Roe remained in force.

After the justices overturned Roe the following year, Paxton kept pushing, pursuing new ways to extend the reach of Texas’ restrictions. He prevailed against the Biden administration, picked fights with states that protect abortion access and pioneered strategies that his peers later adopted or expanded.
snippet: Early in his tenure as Texas attorney general, Ken Paxton issued a statement commemorating what he believed was a national tragedy.

title: Cyberattack on French supermarkets tells us more about food security than AI safety
content:
The cyberattack last week that hit hundreds of French supermarket refrigerators had Europeans wondering if the nonstop warnings about AI risks had finally landed in the real world.

They hadn’t — at least, not yet.

Experts say the attack, which forced hundreds of retailers to throw away defrosted food and spoiled milk, was mostly a reminder of the importance of old-school cybersecurity in safeguarding essential goods and services.

The attack is a “typical example” of how “low-key cyber-enabled sabotage can affect very crucial supply for society,” said Ferdinand Gehringer, hybrid threats lead at FTI Consulting. 

It’s arguably the most consequential hack in the European Union this year, with tangible, disruptive real-world repercussions. France’s Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu personally managed the fallout, which prompted coordination and information-sharing at the EU level. 

The perpetrators, whose identity and motives are currently unknown, hacked into digital systems to remotely raise the temperature of refrigerators in supermarkets including Intermarché and Carrefour.

title: European businesses are keen to go green
content: The EU has a favourite word: competitiveness. To better compete in the global economy, the European Commission is rewriting (and often weakening) environmental rules for businesses, for example to reduce reporting burdens. Making life easier for our biggest industries sounds reasonable: we shouldn't impose rules that drive them out of business, should we? Yet what do businesses actually want? A recent GlobeScan survey commissioned by the environmental group WWF asked 350 European business leaders. Only 29% said the EU's environmental simplification efforts have helped them, while 55% reported a negative or mixed impact. Meanwhile, 91% said shifting to a low-carbon economy will make Europe more competitive in the long run. Some of that frustration comes from companies that moved towards sustainability first. Many invested in line with the Commission's own green rules, and now feel punished by the uncertainty of changing rules. title: How a Massive Chinese Crime Ring Hacked Staples to Steal Millions
content:
A Chinese organized crime group hacked into retail giant Staples, used that access to fraudulently issue millions of dollars worth of gift cards for stores like Target and Sephora, then went on a nationwide shopping spree, shipping many of the stolen electronics and other products back to China as part of a massive retail theft operation, 404 Media has learned.

The finding, based on a review of court records, reveals the scale at which some organized crime groups are fleecing U.S. retailers, with entire warehouses dedicated to housing the merchandise. The hack of Staples, which has not been previously reported, signals just how sophisticated some of these operations have become.

title: Kenya: Authorities must address economic grievances driving protests, end repressive tactics
content:
Kenyan authorities have increasingly used authoritarian tactics, including arbitrary arrests and detention, abductions, malicious prosecution of protesters, surveillance, and media repression, to crack down on protests against deepening economic hardship and the government’s aggressive fiscal policies, Amnesty International said in a new report today. 

The report, “Human Rights Under Siege: Unpacking Authoritarian Practices in an Era of Economic Pressure amid Youth-Led Protests in Kenya”, documents how between 2023 and 2025, increased food and transport costs, levies and tax hikes, high public debt, corruption, rising poverty and inequality, as well as broken electoral promises led to public anger and protests.

“The findings of this report are troubling and paint a stark picture of the Kenyan government’s repressive response to real grievances affecting the day-to-day lives of ordinary people,” said George Morara, Amnesty International Kenya’s Executive Director.

title: Tässä ajassa vastakkainasettelua on liikaa – yllätyin Antti Lindtmanin ulostulosta
content:
Kaikki puolueet ovat jo ottaneet vaalikampanjansa ensi askeleita. Kilpailu lööpeistä tulee kiristymään.

Siksi tullaan näkemään kärjistyksiä, jotka jo nyt näyttävät vahvistavan vastakkainasetteluja. Tuoko vai viekö vastakkainasettelu ääniä, ei ole selvää.

Olin yllättynyt puolueemme puheenjohtaja Antti Lindtmanin ulostulosta, että perussuomalaiset ei mahdu missään olosuhteissa samaan hallitukseen SDP:n kanssa.

Hyvä Suomi osaa ja haluaa ylläpitää vuoropuhelua silloinkin kun mielipiteissä on eroja. Ketään ei saa kategorisesti potkia ulos mielipiteen vuoksi.

KATSELIN huvikseni presidenteiksi valittujen vaaliteemoja ja sloganeita menneiltä vuosilta.

Mikä arvo tai yhteys vaalituloksiin juuri noilla olisi ollut, en tiedä. Päällimmäisenä tulee kuitenkin mieleeni, että yhteiskuntaa yhdistävät teemat ovat kelvanneet kaikille puolueille ja myös äänestäjille. Tämä on tärkeää myös Suomen tulevaisuuden kannalta.

Vuonna 2000 presidentiksi valittiin Tarja Halonen. Hänen sloganeitaan olivat muun muassa ”Kokonaisuus ratkaisee” ja ”Koko kansan presidentti”.

Halonen oli ehdokkaana myös 2006. Tuolloin sloganit olivat ”Koko kansan presidentti” ja ”Tasavallan presidentti”. Halonen oli presidenttinä 2012 saakka.

title: Mali: Military Attacks on Civilians, Insurgent Abuses
content:
(Nairobi) – Malian armed forces and their allies have since July 2026 responded to mounting attacks by Islamist and separatist armed groups with abusive counterinsurgency operations in central and northern Mali, Human Rights Watch said today. 

Mali’s military and the allied Russia-controlled Africa Corps (formally the Wagner Group) have killed and wounded scores of civilians in attacks and in custody in violation of international humanitarian law. Islamist and separatist fighters have also violated the laws-of-war, including torturing and executing captured Malian soldiers. The African Union Peace and Security Council should urgently take action to prevent further atrocities in Mali. 

“The Malian military, armed groups, and insurgent forces are committing grave laws-of-war violations while international organizations and governments largely stand by,” said Ilaria Allegrozzi, senior Sahel researcher at Human Rights Watch. “The AU Peace and Security Council should undertake sustained scrutiny of all parties to Mali’s conflict by convening a dedicated session on civilian protection and accountability and pressing them to halt abuses.”

title: Trump Appointees Asked a Federal Cybersecurity Agency to Secretly Acquire a Voting Machine — and Hack It
content:
A few months into President Donald Trump’s second term, political appointees at the Department of Homeland Security made an unusual request of its agency focused on cybersecurity: Secretly acquire a voting machine and hack it.

The appointees wanted the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to procure the machine, examine it and report back the findings so they could be given to the White House, according to two former administration officials with knowledge of the request. 

The proposition was shocking to CISA’s career staffers, according to one of the former officials. CISA typically worked to thwart hackers. Moreover, the agency had been directed not to alert the voting machine company if it uncovered flaws, contrary to its standard practices. The request made the CISA employees fear they were being asked to take part in political interference.

“My thought was they could keep it in their back pocket to invalidate any [election] results they don’t like,” one of the former officials said. “This goes against everything CISA represents.”

title: Stamps worth more than your house
content: If you've never thought long and hard about stamps, you are most certainly not a philatelist – a student or collector of postage history. During the stamp craze of the mid-19th century, the French spoke about “timbromanie”, or the mania of rabid philatelist collectors. Who would've thought that humble postage stickers would unleash such heated passion among Europe's well-to-do? The most valuable stamps in the world are mostly the freaks among them, including those printed in the wrong colour or displaying their subject upside down. Others are famous for their lore, like the improvised “1856 British Guiana 1-Cent Magenta” (the second stamp in the visual), printed by British colonists after the Crown failed to send them a new batch in time. As such, stamps have always been as much about power as they are about mail. Colonial and imperial rulers used them to thrust their faces into the daily lives of people; Poland and Czechoslovakia, once independent, reissued stamps from elsewhere by printing right over them.

title: Adlercreutz saa tukea kokoomuksesta: ”Nyt tarvitaan lakimuutoksia”
content:
Kokoomus haluaa muuttaa kotiopetuksen luvanvaraiseksi ja varmistaa, että jokainen lapsi saa perusopetuksen edellyttämät tiedot ja taidot, toteaa kansanedustaja Oskari Valtola (kok.).

Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriö julkisti tänään kotiopetusta koskevan selvityksensä. Ministeriön tiedotustilaisuudessa opetusministeri Anders Adlercreutz (rp.) sanoi edistävänsä mallia, jossa kotiopetus muutettaisiin tulevaisuudessa luvanvaraiseksi.

Lakia ei enää tällä kaudella ehditä muuttaa, joten mallin toteuttaminen jää tulevan hallituksen harkittavaksi.

KOTIOPETUKSESSA olevien lasten määrä on yli kolminkertaistunut alle kymmenessä vuodessa. Lähes puolet kotiopetuksessa olleista ei ole saanut peruskoulun päättötodistusta. Valtolan mukaan ministeriön selvitys osoittaa, että kotiopetuksen lainsäädäntö on uudistettava viipymättä.

– Selvitys vahvistaa sen, mistä on ollut huolta jo pitkään. Nykyinen sääntely ei turvaa jokaisen lapsen oikeutta opetukseen. Tilanne, jossa lapsen voi siirtää pois koulusta pelkällä ilmoituksella ja jossa viranomaisilla ei ole keinoja puuttua, ei ole kestävä. Nyt tarvitaan lakimuutoksia, ei enää uusia selvityksiä, Valtola sanoo tiedotteessaan.

title: January 2026 Protests: Mohammad-Javad Mohammadzadeh Tavasani Sentenced to Prison and Flogging
content:
According to HRANA, Mohammad-Javad Mohammadzadeh Tavasani, who is currently held in Azbaram Prison in Lahijan, has been sentenced to imprisonment and flogging.

Based on information received by HRANA, in late August 2026, the Lahijan Criminal Court sentenced Mr. Mohammadzadeh Tavasani to six months in prison and 20 lashes on the charge of “disrupting public order and peace.”

The remaining charges against him, which fall outside the jurisdiction of the Criminal Court, were referred to the Rasht Revolutionary Court. A hearing on this part of his case was held on September 15, 2026, but no verdict has been issued so far.

Previously, at Branch 1 of the Investigation Department of the Lahijan Prosecutor’s Office, he was formally charged with several offenses, including “acting against national security,” “destruction of public property,” “cooperating with foreign media and hostile groups or governments,” “disrupting public order and peace,” and cooperation with Israel.

Mr. Mohammadzadeh Tavasani was arrested at his home by security agents on February 12, 2026. During the arrest, agents searched his residence and confiscated his mobile phone.

title: Indonesian Author Faces Blasphemy Probe for Short Stories
content:
Indonesian police in September began investigating Feby Indirani, the author of the short story collection Memburu Muhammad (Hunting for Muhammad), for alleged blasphemy after an Islamist group allegedly intervened with the organizers of a literary festival at which Indirani was to appear.

Bogor Literary Week organized an event featuring Indirani that was scheduled for September 20 but cancelled it days after the Front Persaudaraan Islam (Islamic Brotherhood Front, FPI) threatened to disrupt the discussion.

In response to a Human Rights Watch query, an Islamic Brotherhood Front representative neither confirmed nor denied the organization’s role in the cancellation of the event, stating: “In principle, FPI respects every citizen's right to express opinions and carry out activities guaranteed by the constitution. However, this right must also be exercised while respecting religious values, public beliefs, and the constitutional rights of others as regulated in the applicable laws.”

title: 40C3 - Bildungsurlaub
content:
Auch dieses Jahr haben wir uns wieder in mehreren Bundesländern um die Anerkennung des Congresses als Bildungsurlaub gekümmert.

Durch Bildungsurlaub könnt ihr für anerkannte Bildungsveranstaltungen bis zu fünf Tage im Jahr zusätzlich zu eurem regulären Urlaub bezahlt von der Arbeit freigestellt werden. Die genauen Voraussetzungen und Regelungen unterscheiden sich je nach Bundesland.

Wie schon in den beiden vergangenen Jahren pflegen wir den aktuellen Anerkennungsstatus nicht mehr hier im Blog, sondern auf der Seite Bildungsurlaub in den Infoseiten. Dort findet ihr den aktuellen Stand für alle Bundesländer, die benötigten Unterlagen und eine Anleitung, wie ihr Bildungsurlaub beantragen könnt.

Bei den Formularen gibt es dieses Jahr eine Änderung: Die zuständigen Behörden haben uns “freundlich” darauf hingewiesen, dass wir für die Anmelde- und die Teilnahmebescheinigung doch bitte die offiziellen Vorlagen der Bundesländer verwenden sollen. Wie das funktioniert, erklären wir ebenfalls auf der Infoseite.

Bitte bringt eure ausgedruckte Teilnahmebescheinigung zum Congress mit und lasst sie vor Ort abstempeln. Eine nachträgliche Bestätigung ist leider nicht möglich.

title: Indonesia: President Prabowo’s two years marred by regression of civic freedoms
content:
CIVICUS, a global civil society alliance, urges President Prabowo Subianto to halt his assault on civic freedoms and to adhere to Indonesia’s human rights obligations. Two years since he came to power – on 20 October 2024 - the situation of civic space is regressing, as highlighted in a CIVICUS brief published today.

Over the last two years, CIVICUS has documented attacks, harassment, prosecutions and surveillance targeting dozens of human rights defenders. The criminalisation and detention of eight activists on baseless charges following the August 2025 protests and the acid attack on activist Andrie Yunus in March 2026 illustrates the serious risks and dangers faced by many for undertaking their activism under this regime.

title: Building Bridges between Bangladesh-China through Wikimedia
content:
How university life in Changsha became an opportunity to bring language, culture, and free knowledge together.

When I moved to Changsha, China to study Electrical Engineering and Automation at Changsha University of Science and Technology (CSUST), I was also thinking of a different kind of infrastructure: the infrastructure of knowledge, language and cultural representation on the internet.

As a polyglot Bengali and Sylheti-speaking student, far away from Bangladesh, the Wikimedia projects were a way to stay connected to my language and be part of a global movement for free knowledge. In 2019, that interest began to take shape beyond individual edits, through in-person gatherings that brought Bangla Wikipedia contributors and Chinese Wikimedians together. In 2020, I was featured by Changsha Evening News for my involvement in promoting cultural exchange between Bangladesh and China as a cultural ambassador.

title: Activists push for Pakistan to recognise and support people with albinism
content:
Pakistan keeps no data on people with albinism, leaving needs unmet in schools, healthcare, and jobs.

Originally published on Global Voices

Graph from the 2021 study “Genetic Causes of Oculocutaneous Albinism in Pakistani Population.” Sajid et al., Genes 2021, 12(4), 492. CC BY 4.0 via MDPI.

For Adeel Nasir, 24, who has albinism and lives in Kot Radha Kishan, a town in Kasur district, Punjab Province of Pakistan, school meant constant adjustment to challenges that many people around him did not understand.

Because of low vision, he struggled to read what was written on classroom whiteboards. Some teachers seated him closer to the board, improved the lighting, and gave him written notes. But one classroom incident remained painful.

Adeel once asked a teacher what qualifications a fighter pilot needs. He expected encouragement about his ambition. Instead, he received a response focused on his eyesight.

“First of all, you should be able to see clearly with your eyes,” Adeel recalled the teacher saying.

His classmates laughed. Years later, he says people still notice his condition before they recognise his abilities.

title: Wikipedia often gets taken for granted – but its history is fascinating, and its future is fragile
content:
Wikipedia’s 68m articles have been consulted trillions of times. Not bad for a website that has barely changed since it was founded 20 years ago

A few years ago, I was struck by the tension between how Wikipedia was used, and how it was talked about. Everyone was on it all the time, and yet its reputation had stalled at “don’t trust it”, because it was the “free encyclopedia that anyone can edit”.

Clearly people were trusting it, so much so it had become part of the fabric of everyday life since it was founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger in 2001. But despite the fact it now has been consulted trillions of times by billions of people (English Wikipedia alone is 5.2bn words long), it inspires an odd lack of curiosity. Even people donating to Wikipedia might say the money was “for the factcheckers”, though there aren’t any – not paid ones, anyway. Meanwhile, the internet in the social media era had begun to feel like a much uglier place, and some digital nostalgia was setting in: here was this holdover that had somehow survived; a website that functions – and even looks – much the same as it did 20 years ago.

title: Video game film adaptations used to be huge flops. Now studios can’t get enough
content:
In the early 1990s, when the home video game market was still in its infancy, Hollywood attempted to leverage the appeal of this emerging entertainment for feature length films.

The resulting movies – including Super Mario Bros. (1993), Mortal Kombat (1995), and the Jean Claude Van Damme-starring Street Fighter (1994) – largely bombed in their critical reception.

Today, however, video game to film adaptations are filling multiplexes, from blockbusters such as A Minecraft Movie (2025), to elevated horrors such as the recent Resident Evil (2026) film, and lower-budget breakouts like Iron Lung (2026).

As Street Fighter swing-kicks its way back into cinemas, it’s worth looking at how, and why, the video game-to-film pipeline has started gushing anew.

Film studios favour projects that will simultaneously appeal to younger and older audiences. This explains why there are so many live action Disney remakes.

The current video game film adaptation trend kicked off around 2020 – made possible by a cross-generational audience that didn’t exist a few decades ago.

title: Did Mendel Breed Mice?
content:
We are delighted to share a new essay from our group, published open access in . Many genetics students have heard that Mendel first studied inheritance in mice, saw the segregation of fur colour, and switched to peas only when a disapproving bishop objected to a friar watching rodents mate. It is a wonderful story, but is it true?

The paper traces the tale back to its only source, Hugo Iltis, who interviewed people who had known Mendel and reported that he kept white and grey mice in his rooms at the abbey. Iltis himself presented any crossing experiments as his own speculation. The essay sets this against the real tensions of the time, including the hostility of Bishop Schaffgotsch towards St Thomas’s Abbey, and shows that the famous remark attributed to Mendel, that the bishop did not realise plants also have sex, is a modern literary invention with no historical basis.

That Mendel kept mice is plausible, but what he did with them remains unknown. The story, the paper argues, is a fine example of how anecdotes gather around famous scientists and of the temptation to read the past through what we already know.

title: Beyond Wikipedia: Training Editors with Wikimedia Nigeria, Rivers Network

When you hear Wikipedia, do you ever stop to think about the other Wikimedia projects?

That was the idea behind Beyond Wikipedia: Exploring the Wikimedia Projects, a training series organised by Wikimedia Nigeria,Rivers Network, where different trainers took participants through different Wikimedia projects, including Diff, Wikiquote, Wikiversity, Wikimedia Commons, Wikisource, and Wikipedia. I was one of the trainers, and I handled the Wikipedia session.

Nubel Bariloe, the Vice President of the Network, reached out to invite me to be one of the trainers. I was like, why not? I appreciated how he handled the invitation. He sent a formal invitation and followed up with me about the date. I would tell him I remembered. One thing I particularly appreciated was his communication. title: Bridges Built: EduWiki Hub and ESEAP Hub Strengthen Access to Wikimedia Education
content:
What can happen when a global education-focused community and a regional Wikimedia hub connect their existing work?

For the EduWiki Hub and the Wikimedia East, Southeast Asia and the Pacific (ESEAP) Hub, the answer has been a practical partnership focused on making Wikimedia education opportunities more accessible, visible, and relevant to communities across the ESEAP region.

The collaboration has grown around a shared principle: accessibility and inclusivity. Rather than creating a separate program, the two hubs have connected existing activities, resources, and community networks to help more people participate.

One of the most concrete areas of collaboration has been language access. Through the ESEAP Hub’s Community Translator Program, EduWiki Hub activities including Knowledge Showcases, Workshops, and the Newcomer’s Starter Kit orientation have received interpretation support, including Indonesian and Chinese interpretation.
snippet: What can happen when a global education-focused community and a regional Wikimedia hub connect their existing work?

title: At the UN, plans for a global coalition to attack LGBTQ+ and reproductive rights
content:
Far-right activists are trying to dismantle global protections for LGBTQ+ people under the guise of ‘family values’

US President Trump speaking at the U.N. General Assembly. Photo by The White House. Fair use.

This article by Hope Pisoni was originally published by Uncloseted Media, an LGBTQ+ focused investigative news outlet, on October 1, 2026. An edited version is being republished on Global Voices as part of a content partnership agreement. It has been edited for length and style.

On September 17, while the United Nations (U.N.) was hosting its annual General Assembly for diplomats and leaders from all over the world, several key figures filled a room across the street at the Millennium Hilton in Midtown Manhattan. Attendees included Trump administration officials, leaders of anti-LGBTQ+ hate groups, far-right politicians from Latin America and reporters from far-right media.

These people were meeting for the Global Forum for Life, Family and Freedoms, a two-day summit of right-wing leaders with an ambitious goal to create a new “pro-life and pro-family” Core Group at the U.N.

title: Pienten museoiden aarteet digitaaliseen maailmaan
content:
Miten pienen paikallismuseon kokoelmat saadaan yhä useampien ulottuville? Entä miten digitaaliset aineistot säilyvät myös tuleville sukupolville? Näitä kysymyksiä pohdittiin tällä viikolla neljän päivän ajan Kotiseutuliiton toimistossa Helsingissä, johon suomalaiset ja virolaiset museot kokoontuivat EU:n Central Baltic -ohjelman rahoittaman Comand-hankkeen ensimmäisellä yhteisellä koulutusjaksolla ja opintomatkalla.

Suomen ja Viron yhteisessä Comand-hankkeessa kehitetään pienten museoiden digitointiosaamista ja etsitään uusia tapoja esitellä paikallista kulttuuriperintöä. Mukana on neljä suomalaista ja kuusi virolaista museota.

Helsingissä museoiden työntekijät ja vapaaehtoiset perehtyivät kokoelmien digitointiin, digitaaliseen tarinankerrontaan ja näyttelyiden suunnitteluun.

Museoesineen digitointi voi yksinkertaisimmillaan tarkoittaa valokuvaamista. Parhaimmillaan esineestä tai kokonaisesta rakennuksesta voidaan luoda kolmiulotteinen digitaalinen malli, jota voi tarkastella eri suunnista tai hyödyntää esimerkiksi peleissä.

title: Stefan Backas är årets Frans Henrikson-pristagare
content:
Ljuddesignern och ljudteknikern Stefan Backas får årets pris ur Frans Henriksons testamentsfond inom Svenska kulturfonden. Priset är på 20 000 euro och delas ut i samband med donatorns födelsedag den 2 november.

– Som barn byggde jag de märkligaste uppfinningar av gamla kassettbandspelare. Intresset för tekniken öppnade dörren till ljudets och musikens värld, och där trivs jag fortfarande bäst, säger Stefan Backas som Svenska kulturfonden nu prisbelönar för hans arbete inom ljuddesign och ljudteknik.

Ljudvärlden har i över 20 år varit Stefan Backas profession och passion.

– Ljudet och musiken har tagit mig till teatrar, studior, konsertsalar och ut i naturen. Men oavsett vilken miljö jag befinner mig i handlar det alltid om samma sak: att lyssna. På rummet, på naturen och på människorna. Ett ljud består inte enbart av ljudvågor, utan också av den känsla och avsikt vi lägger in i det, säger Stefan Backas.

“Stefan Backas har under mer än två decennier satt sin prägel på studio- och liveinspelningar, ljuddesign för film, teater och tv samt en lång rad konstnärliga projekt. Genom sitt mångsidiga kunnande har han blivit en självklar kraft inom ljuddesign och ljudteknik.

title: Fake Linda and me: the Agatha Christie-worthy mystery of the fraudster who stole my byline
content:
How a string of bizarre events led writer Linda Geddes to don her sleuthing cap and dig into a world of shadowy impersonators

It started with an entirely ordinary interaction on LinkedIn. Someone had tagged me in a post, saying how much they’d enjoyed contributing to a New York Post article I’d written about “chronoworking”. As the author of a book about circadian rhythms, it was exactly the sort of subject I might write about. Except I’d never heard of this person, let alone interviewed them.

I clicked on the link and my stomach dropped. There, above an article about people who organise their working lives around their biological clocks, was my name: Linda Geddes.

title: Representation, Visibility, and Contact Zones: the North America Hub at WikiConference North America 2026
content:
Last month, Wikimedians from across the continent gathered in beautiful Edmonton, Alberta for WikiConference North America (WCNA) 2026—an opportunity to share projects, learn from one another, and think collectively about what it means to build and sustain the knowledge commons. For those of us working on the Wikimedia North America Hub, it was also a wonderful chance to meet so many community members in person and listen to the extraordinary work already happening across our region.

Throughout the conference, one theme surfaced repeatedly: representation is not simply a matter of adding more information. It requires attention to whose knowledge becomes visible, who gets to participate in creating it, and what structures shape that participation.

title: ‘You can’t make this stuff up’: why we remain fascinated by Elizabeth Holmes
content:
The entrepreneur turned fraudster is the subject of an Oscar-tipped new documentary that takes an unusual look at her strange legacy

David Agus’s first encounter with Elizabeth Holmes at a health conference came as a shock. The Holmes he met in the green room was personable and pleasant. The Holmes he interviewed on stage was altogether different.

“The accent changed: this deep voice, very serious,” Agus, a medical oncologist, recalls by phone from Los Angeles. “It was as if I had met a person and then interviewed a separate person. That transition from the green room to the stage – I had never experienced something like that before.”

title: Indic MediaWiki Developers User Group WikiConference India 2026 Report
content:
WikiConference India 2026 was the fourth edition of the national conference. It was held in Kochi, Kerala, from 4–6 September 2026 and hosted by the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad, in collaboration with the Wikimedians of Kerala User Group. The conference brought together Wikimedians, developers, researchers, educators, community organisers and other contributors, with more than 220 participants from India and other countries. The conference was organised around the theme “Reimagining the Knowledge Commons: Community Leadership in an Evolving Wikimedia Ecosystem.”

Indic MediaWiki Developers User Group (IMDUG) works to provide technical support to Indic Wikimedia projects and communities through technical capacity-building activities. For the IMDUG, WCI 2026 provided an opportunity to engage directly with Wikimedia editor communities and better understand the technical challenges they face in their day-to-day workflows.

title: Azerbaijan: Stop denying access to education through discriminatory hijab restrictions and release peaceful protesters
content:
Reacting to the growing number of reports that peaceful activists protesting the school hijab ban have been detained and that an activist who attempted to organize free online lessons for girls affected by the uniform regulations has gone missing, Marie Struthers, Amnesty International’s Eastern Europe and Central Asia Director, said:

“Mass arrests of peaceful protesters alongside participants in violent riots, including the reported detention of a mother protesting against her daughter’s exclusion from school, and the disappearance of an activist who aimed to help affected girls, are typical of the state’s violent suppression of the lawful exercise of the right to protest peacefully, and the crackdown on freedom of expression and all dissent in Azerbaijan.

“Denying girls access to classrooms because they wear a hijab is discriminatory and violates their rights to education, and the freedoms of religion and expression. The secular character of public education doesn’t justify a blanket restriction on religious dress.

title: COP17: Which countries have released new pledges to tackle nature loss?
content:
Some 58% of countries have met a UN call to submit new pledges on addressing nature loss – two years after the original deadline – according to Carbon Brief analysis.

Countries were asked to submit new pledges, known as national biodiversity strategies and action plans (NBSAPs), by the start of the COP16 biodiversity summit in October 2024.

After only 15% of nations met the original deadline, countries agreed at the summit to a new text that “urges” countries to release their NBSAPs “as soon as possible”.

Carbon Brief analysis shows that 113 countries have now come forward with new NBSAPs – up from 55 nations a year ago.

Countries will gather in Yerevan, Armenia, next week for COP17.

COP17 marks the halfway point of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF), a landmark agreement made in 2022 to reverse nature decline by 2030.

The summit will provide the stage for the first global review of countries’ progress towards meeting the targets of the GBF.

In Montreal, Canada, in 2022, nearly every country in the world agreed to the GBF. The overall “mission” of the framework is to “halt and reverse” biodiversity loss by 2030.

title: Changing Ukraine’s President Will Change Nothing
content:
Donald Trump thinks Ukraine needs a new president. Vladimir Putin agrees, as does Elon Musk, and the point was once made by that great friend of Ukraine, the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. So, let’s imagine that, somehow, fair and free elections with no Russian interference were to be held tomorrow in Ukraine. Who would win?

According to a September 23 public opinion survey conducted by a respected polling outfit, the winner would either be Ukraine’s incumbent president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, with 23% or Gen. Valery Zaluzhny, the former commander in chief of Ukraine’s Armed Forces, with 22.9%. Former President Petro Poroshenko comes in third with 10.7%. Fourth place goes to Zelenskyy’s intelligence aide, Kyrylo Budanov, with 9.5%, while fifth goes to the far-right politician and commander of the 3rd Army Corps of the Ukrainian Ground Forces, Andrii Biletsky, with 8.7%. Other polls show similar results.
